items.title: 非農強勁也無感！美國家庭財務惡化、失業率預期創逾6年新高
items.title_en: Strong Nonfarm Payrolls Still Unfelt: US Household Finances Worsen, Unemployment Rate Outlook Hits Over Six-Year High
paras: 紐約聯準銀行周二(8日)公布的8月消費者預期調查顯示，美國家庭對個人財務及整體就業市場的看法轉趨悲觀。儘管通膨預期大致穩定，愈來愈多受訪者認為自身財務狀況已經惡化，並擔心未來一年失業率上升。
調查顯示，認為家庭財務狀況較一年前「差很多」或「差一些」的受訪者占比，從7月的37.6%升至38.6%；預期未來一年財務狀況將惡化的比例，也由30.3%攀升至32.6%。受訪者對目前及未來取得信用的難易程度同樣更加悲觀。
勞動市場訊號則呈現分歧。受訪者認為自己未來一年失去工作的機率降至13.8%，創2月以來最低；主動離職機率連續第二個月上升至19.5%，高於過去12個月平均。這兩項變化主要由最高學歷為高中及家庭年收入低於10萬美元的族群推動。
不過，預期全美失業率未來一年上升的平均機率攀至44.4%，創2020年4月新冠疫情重創經濟以來最高，而且各年齡、教育及收入族群均轉趨悲觀。若意外失業，受訪者認為3個月內找到新工作的機率也降至45%。
物價方面，消費者對未來一年及5年的通膨預期分別維持在3.6%與3%；未來3年通膨預期則由3.3%小幅降至3.2%。不過，受訪者預期一年後汽油價格將進一步上漲。
這份調查出爐前，美國8月非農就業意外增加16.2萬人，超越市場所有預測，失業率則維持在4.1%，顯示即使面臨對伊戰爭與通膨持續偏高等不確定性，勞動市場仍具韌性。
聯準會(Fed)將於9月15日至16日召開決策會議，此前已連續5次按兵不動，目前政策利率維持在3.50%至3.75%。美國周四將公布8月生產者物價指數(PPI)，周五公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)則可能決定Fed本月是否升息。
Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)表示，若通膨繼續朝2%目標改善，他願意支持維持利率不變；但克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克(Beth Hammack)認為，物價壓力仍然沉重，現在已是採取行動壓低通膨的時候。
paras_en: The New York Fed released its August Consumer Expectations Survey on Tuesday (the 8th), showing that U.S. households are becoming increasingly pessimistic about their personal finances and the overall labor market. While inflation expectations remain roughly stable, a growing share of respondents say their own financial situation has deteriorated and they fear unemployment could rise over the next year.

The survey found that respondents who said their household finances were "much worse" or "somewhat worse" than a year ago rose to 38.6% from 37.6% in July, and the share expecting their financial situation to worsen over the next year climbed to 32.6% from 30.3%. Respondents also grew more pessimistic about the ease of obtaining credit now and in the future.

Labor‑market signals were mixed. The probability respondents assigned to losing their job in the next year fell to 13.8%, the lowest since February, while the chance of voluntarily quitting rose for the second month in a row to 19.5%, above the 12‑month average. These shifts were driven mainly by those whose highest education level is high school and whose household income is under $100,000.

Nevertheless, the average probability that the national unemployment rate will rise over the next year jumped to 44.4%, the highest since the pandemic‑hit April 2020, and pessimism spread across all age, education and income groups. If they were to lose their job unexpectedly, respondents said the chance of finding a new job within three months fell to 45%.

On prices, consumers kept their one‑year and five‑year inflation expectations at 3.6% and 3.0% respectively, while the three‑year outlook slipped slightly to 3.2% from 3.3%. However, respondents expect gasoline prices to rise further a year from now.

Before this survey was released, August non‑farm payrolls unexpectedly added 162,000 jobs, beating all market forecasts, while the unemployment rate held at 4.1%, indicating that despite uncertainties such as the war in Ukraine and persistently high inflation, the labor market remains resilient.

The Federal Reserve will hold its policy meeting on September 15‑16; it has paused for five consecutive meetings, leaving the target range for the policy rate at 3.50%‑3.75%. The U.S. will publish the August Producer Price Index on Thursday, and Friday’s Consumer Price Index release could determine whether the Fed raises rates this month.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller said that if inflation continues to move toward the 2% goal, he is willing to support keeping rates unchanged; but Boston Fed President Beth Hammack argued that price pressures remain heavy and it is time to act to bring inflation down.

items.title: 被質疑變相印鈔救債市！貝森特：擴大美債回購只是退燒、不是QE
items.title_en: Questioned as a Disguised Money‑Printing Bailout for the Bond Market! Bessent: Expanding Treasury Repurchases Is Just a Fever‑Reduction, Not QE
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周二(8日)表示，上月擴大回購舊債計畫，是為了替持續升溫的美國公債市場「退燒」，讓市場價格重新朝均衡狀態靠攏，而非試圖人為壓低殖利率。
貝森特在華盛頓出席Breitbart News活動時表示，他的職責是努力推動市場回歸均衡，雖然財政部無法改變均衡價格，但市場實際上從來不會完全處於均衡狀態。
這番談話發表之際，財政部預定周三進行擴大計畫後首場長天期舊債回購操作。此前，30年期美債殖利率一度升至2007年以來最高，引發市場對長債需求、財政赤字及政府舉債能力的疑慮。
曾任避險基金主管的貝森特表示，當時債市就像正在發燒，投機交易者往往會試圖加速市場走勢，因此財政部有必要介入，避免波動自我強化。財政部透過買回流動性較差的舊債，可望改善交易環境並緩解市場失序風險。
不過，貝森特否認近期美債價格下跌，是因投資人擔憂美國政府借款規模及信用狀況。他指出，如果市場真的質疑美國信用，投資人理應賣出美債、轉買德國公債，但實際走勢恰好相反，美債表現仍優於德債。
貝森特也反駁外界把擴大回購視為另一種量化寬鬆(QE)的說法。QE是聯準會(Fed)過去在危機期間透過大規模購債壓低利率、刺激經濟的政策工具，而財政部此次行動主要著眼於改善債市運作，並非放寬貨幣政策。
他將這項計畫形容為Fed過去「扭轉操作」(Operation Twist)的某種版本，透過調整不同期限債券的供需結構，緩解長天期市場壓力。貝森特強調，財政部只是為債市降溫及恢復秩序，並不是在推動QE。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Tuesday (the 8th) that the expansion of the old‑debt repurchase program last month was intended to “reduce the fever” in the overheating U.S. Treasury market, nudging prices back toward equilibrium rather than artificially suppressing yields.

Speaking at a Breitbart News event in Washington, Bessent said his job is to help steer the market back to balance; while the Treasury cannot set the equilibrium price, the market never truly sits at equilibrium in practice.

The remarks came as the Treasury prepared to conduct the first long‑term old‑debt repurchase under the expanded plan on Wednesday. Earlier, the 30‑year Treasury yield had spiked to its highest level since 2007, raising concerns about demand for long bonds, the fiscal deficit, and the government’s borrowing capacity.

Bessent, a former hedge‑fund manager, likened the bond market at the time to a feverish patient, noting that speculative traders tend to accelerate market moves, so Treasury intervention was needed to prevent self‑reinforcing volatility. By buying back less‑liquid older issues, the Treasury hopes to improve trading conditions and ease the risk of market disorder.

However, Bessent denied that the recent decline in Treasury prices was driven by investor worries about the size of U.S. borrowing or credit quality. He pointed out that if the market truly doubted U.S. credit, investors would sell Treasuries and shift to German bonds, yet the opposite occurred, with Treasuries outperforming German debt.

Bessent also rejected the view that the expanded repurchase program amounts to another round of quantitative easing (QE). QE was a tool the Federal Reserve used during crises to buy large amounts of bonds, lower rates and spur growth, whereas this Treasury action is aimed at improving market functioning, not loosening monetary policy.

He described the plan as a variant of the Fed’s past “Operation Twist,” adjusting the supply‑demand balance across different maturities to relieve pressure in the long‑term market. Bessent stressed that the Treasury is simply cooling the bond market and restoring order, not launching QE.

items.title: 格芯獲美商務部3.75億美元研發補助 携手Rigetti、Quantinuum打造美國量子晶片製造樞紐
items.title_en: GlobalFoundries Receives $375 Million U.S. Department of Commerce R&D Grant, Partners with Rigetti and Quantinuum to Build a U.S. Quantum Chip Manufacturing Hub
paras: 美國晶片製造商格芯週二(8日)宣布，已與美國商務部《晶片法案》研發辦公室敲定最終協議，獲得3.75億美元研發資助，以加快其量子技術解決方案(QTS)業務的發展軌跡。該業務旨在擴大美國本土基於量子計算的半導體製造規模，並鞏固美國在全球「下一代計算革命」，也就是量子運算領域的領先地位。
根據補貼協議，格芯有資格在五年內獲得最高3.75億美元資金，具體撥付與指定里程碑的達成情況掛鉤。
幾乎同一時間，美國本土三大量子運算新勢力同傳捷報：Rigetti Computing與D-Wave Quantum週二股價開盤大漲近10%，Quantinuum漲逾5%。三者週二也跟美國商務部簽署最終協議，獲得1億美元資金，用於加速研發項目，應對超導量子計算機大規模擴展過程中的關鍵技術挑戰。
美方此輪補助金分配，凸顯其對掌握量子運算核心製造基礎的重視。IBM與格芯兩筆補助合計13.75億美元，占總額約68.3%。IBM打算配套投入10億美元現金，使其Anderon項目初始現金投入達20億美元，並建設服務IBM及外部客戶的300毫米量子晶圓代工平台。
由此可見，美國希望同時占據量子晶片工藝、製造產能、供應鏈與商業生態的關鍵位置，而非僅押注單一量子公司的突破。川普政府6月公布的量子行政行動，則進一步強調國家戰略、可信供應鏈及產業化。
paras_en: GlobalFoundries, the U.S. chipmaker, announced on Tuesday (the 8th) that it has reached a final agreement with the U.S. Department of Commerce’s CHIPS Act R&D office, securing a $375 million research and development grant to accelerate the trajectory of its Quantum Technology Solutions (QTS) business. The initiative aims to expand domestic semiconductor manufacturing based on quantum computing and to cement the United States’ leading position in the global “next‑generation computing revolution,” i.e., the quantum computing arena.
Under the subsidy agreement, GlobalFoundries is eligible to receive up to $375 million over five years, with disbursements tied to the achievement of specified milestones.

Almost simultaneously, three major U.S. quantum‑computing newcomers reported good news: Rigetti Computing and D‑Wave Quantum saw their stock prices jump nearly 10% at market open on Tuesday, while Quantinuum rose more than 5%. The three also signed final agreements with the U.S. Department of Commerce, receiving a combined $100 million to speed up R&D projects and address key technical challenges in scaling superconducting quantum computers.

The U.S. grant allocation underscores the emphasis on mastering the core manufacturing foundations of quantum computing. Grants to IBM and GlobalFoundries together total $1.375 billion, about 68.3% of the overall pot. IBM plans to match with $1 billion in cash, bringing its Anderson project’s initial cash investment to $2 billion and building a 300‑mm quantum wafer foundry platform serving IBM and external customers.

This shows that the United States seeks to occupy the critical positions of quantum‑chip process technology, manufacturing capacity, supply chain, and commercial ecosystem, rather than betting on a single quantum firm’s breakthrough. The quantum executive action announced by the Trump administration in June further emphasizes national strategy, a trusted supply chain, and industrialization.

items.title: 汎瑋8月、前8月營收雙創新高 受惠電子材料應用拓展AI強勁需求
items.title_en: PanWei's August and Year-to-Date Revenues Hit Record Highs, Boosted by Expanding Electronic Materials Applications and Strong AI Demand
paras: 電子機能材料廠汎瑋材料(6967-TW)今(8)日公告8月營收為為13.3億元、月減11.65％、年增1.12％，累計今(2026)年1-8月合併營收達11.05億元，較去年同期大幅成長22.98％。汎瑋表示，延續電子功能性材料在工業電腦及AI伺服器等應用拓展，今年以來強勁的營運成長動能，也帶動8月、前8月合併營收雙雙改寫歷年同期新高。
汎瑋表示，前8月營收主要受惠近年持續深耕高附加價值電子功能性材料解決方案，旗下導電、散熱、電磁屏蔽、絕緣等產品在工業電腦及AI伺服器等終端應用持續拓展，帶動工業電腦及AI伺服器相關產品需求強勁成長，前8月相關終端應用產品營收較去(2025)年同期成長188％。
此外，汎瑋也受惠電動車品牌車廠交車量增加，汽車隔熱紙需求同步提升，亦挹注3M產品經銷業務成長，使電子功能性材料解決方案及經銷業務雙向挹注整體營運，推升前8月營收維持雙位數成長。

汎瑋也觀察到，目前全球AI伺服器需求強勁增長，帶動整體產業鏈進入新一輪升級週期，但同時地緣政治與美國製造政策也正快速改寫全球科技供應鏈版圖，使產業朝向「全球在地化」布局。面對此一趨勢，汎瑋憑「區域供應」的跨國韌性供應網，除了台灣與中國生產基地外，亦持續強化東南亞(越南、馬來西亞)布局，將以靈活的供貨彈性與全球在地化支援能力，成功承接供應鏈轉移帶來的新訂單，主要涵蓋筆記型電腦、智慧家電等應用，預計於今(2026)年第4季末後陸續放量，帶動相關產品出貨與營收貢獻同步提升。
汎瑋表示，隨著客戶持續擴大在亞洲區域的產能配置，公司亦將持續深化全球在地化供應布局，透過多區域生產與供應鏈整合優勢，提升客戶導入意願及長期合作深度，進一步掌握供應鏈移轉所帶來的市場商機。
展望下半年，汎瑋也維持審慎樂觀，除了持續深耕AI伺服器、HPC及智慧家電等既有高階應用市場，汎瑋也將進一步掌握下一波AI硬體升級商機，積極將既有高可靠度、高導熱及EMI防護材料技術延伸至更多新興終端應用，並透過全球在地化供應布局與材料技術整合，加速拓展高附加價值應用市場，優化產品組合與營運結構，以挹注未來整體營運保持穩健成長動能。
paras_en: Electronic functional materials manufacturer PanWei Materials (6967-TW) announced today that August revenue was NT$1.33 billion, down 11.65% month‑over‑month but up 1.12% year‑over‑year. Cumulative consolidated revenue for January‑August 2026 reached NT$11.05 billion, a sharp 22.98% increase from the same period last year. PanWei said that continued expansion of electronic functional materials in industrial computers and AI servers has driven strong operating momentum this year, leading both August and year‑to‑date revenues to set new historical highs for the same months.

PanWei noted that the year‑to‑date revenue benefited from its deepening focus on high‑value‑added electronic functional material solutions. Its conductive, thermal‑management, electromagnetic‑shielding and insulating products have continued to expand in industrial computers and AI servers, spurring robust demand for related products. Revenue from these end‑application segments grew 188% compared with the same period in 2025.

In addition, PanWei gained from the increase in vehicle deliveries by electric‑vehicle brands, which lifted demand for automotive heat‑shield films. This also boosted its 3M product distribution business, allowing both the electronic functional material solutions and distribution channels to feed each other and drive double‑digit year‑to‑date growth.

PanWei observed that global AI‑server demand is rising sharply, pushing the entire supply chain into a new upgrade cycle. At the same time, geopolitical tensions and U.S. manufacturing policies are rapidly reshaping the global tech supply‑chain map, prompting a shift toward “global localization.” To meet this trend, PanWei leverages a resilient, cross‑border supply network – with production bases in Taiwan and China and an expanding footprint in Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Malaysia) – to offer flexible delivery and localized support. It aims to capture new orders from the supply‑chain shift, mainly for notebook computers and smart home appliances, with volumes expected to ramp up after the end of Q4 2026, boosting shipments and revenue contributions.

PanWei said that as customers continue to expand capacity in the Asian region, the company will further deepen its global localized supply layout. By integrating multi‑regional production and supply‑chain advantages, it seeks to increase customer adoption willingness and deepen long‑term cooperation, thereby seizing market opportunities created by supply‑chain transitions.

Looking ahead to the second half of the year, PanWei remains cautiously optimistic. While continuing to deepen its presence in existing high‑end markets such as AI servers, HPC and smart home appliances, the company will also capture the next wave of AI‑hardware upgrade opportunities. It plans to extend its high‑reliability, high‑thermal‑conductivity and EMI‑protection material technologies to more emerging end‑applications, and accelerate growth in high‑value‑added markets through its global localized supply network and material‑technology integration, optimizing its product mix and operating structure to sustain robust growth momentum.

items.title: 阿斯特捷利康COPD新藥告捷！年銷售高峰估逾50億美元
items.title_en: AstraZeneca's COPD New Drug Triumphs, Forecasts Over $5 Billion Annual Sales
paras: 英國製藥大廠阿斯特捷利康(AZN-US)周二(8日)公布兩項慢性阻塞性肺病(COPD)後期臨床試驗完整結果，實驗性生物製劑tozorakimab可使廣泛患者族群的中度及重度急性惡化減少約30%，不僅達到或超越分析師預期，也提高這款藥物成為年銷售額逾50億美元重磅產品的希望。
Tozorakimab目前正接受美國食品藥物管理局(FDA)優先審查，預計最快2027年第一季取得美國批准，歐盟與中國等主要市場也在審查中。這款藥物每4周注射一次，在兩項試驗的主要前吸菸者族群中，分別使中度及重度急性惡化減少29%與34%；涵蓋目前及過去吸菸者的整體族群中，降幅則分別達30%與29%。
試驗結果已刊登於《新英格蘭醫學期刊》(New England Journal of Medicine)，並在歐洲呼吸學會年會發表。阿斯特捷利康表示，患者整體耐受性良好，主要不良反應為注射部位反應。

突破現有療法限制 低嗜酸性球患者也受益

COPD是一種會阻塞氣流、造成呼吸困難的漸進性肺部疾病，症狀包括咳嗽、反覆胸腔感染及呼吸急促，目前無法治癒，但治療可延緩惡化。阿斯特捷利康估計，美國確診及未確診患者合計約1,600萬至2,600萬人，COPD也是美國第五大死因。
目前已獲准治療COPD的生物製劑，包括再生元製藥(REGN-US)與賽諾菲(SNY-US)共同開發的Dupixent，以及葛蘭素史克(GSK-US)的Nucala，但主要適用於嗜酸性球數值偏高的患者。嗜酸性球是一種與發炎反應有關的白血球，現有療法僅能涵蓋約30%的COPD患者，其餘約70%患者獲益有限或完全無效。
Tozorakimab試驗則納入現有及過去吸菸者、不同肺功能嚴重程度，以及各種嗜酸性球數值的患者。分析顯示，在嗜酸性球數值低於150的族群中，急性惡化減少23%；數值達150以上者減少34%，300以上者降幅更達43%。
阿斯特捷利康生物製藥事業部總裁Ruud Dobber表示，目前沒有生物製劑可供嗜酸性球數值低於150的COPD患者使用，tozorakimab憑藉廣泛適用性，有機會真正改變治療模式。

阻斷兩條IL-33路徑 年銷售額上看50億美元

Tozorakimab藉由阻斷會引發發炎與黏液生成的免疫蛋白IL-33發揮作用。其他藥廠過去開發抗IL-33療法的成果有限，包括賽諾菲與羅氏(RHHBY-US)旗下藥物均未展現同等成效，導致投資人一度質疑這類療法的潛力。
阿斯特捷利康認為，tozorakimab成功之處在於可同時抑制兩條不同的IL-33路徑，不只能控制發炎，也可能減少黏液生成與呼吸道損傷。執行長蘇博科(Pascal Soriot)坦言，公司原先也認為成功機率不高，市場預測幾乎未替這款藥物計入任何價值，最終結果卻證明藥物有效。
阿斯特捷利康近期將tozorakimab的年銷售高峰預測提高至逾50億美元，可望協助公司實現2030年營收800億美元的目標。該藥目前也正進行重度氣喘第二期試驗及重度病毒性下呼吸道疾病第三期試驗，未來還可能擴及支氣管擴張症等由IL-33驅動的疾病。
不過，密西根大學醫療體系肺部與重症照護部門主管Meilan Han指出，由於尚無試驗直接比較tozorakimab與Dupixent及Nucala，醫師仍須判斷對嗜酸性球偏高患者應優先採用哪種療法，未來需要更多子群分析才能確立其治療定位。
paras_en: AstraZeneca (AZN-US) announced on Tuesday the complete results of two late‑stage clinical trials for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). The experimental biologic tozorakimab reduced moderate and severe acute exacerbations by about 30% across a broad patient population, meeting or exceeding analyst expectations and raising hopes that the drug could become a product generating more than $5 billion in annual sales.

Tozorakimab is currently under priority review by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and could receive U.S. approval as early as the first quarter of 2027, with the European Union, China and other major markets also reviewing it. The drug is administered by injection every four weeks and, in the two trials’ primary former‑smoker cohorts, cut moderate and severe acute exacerbations by 29% and 34% respectively; in the overall population that includes current and former smokers, the reductions were 30% and 29%.

The trial results were published in the New England Journal of Medicine and presented at the European Respiratory Society annual meeting. AstraZeneca said overall tolerability was good, with the main adverse event being injection‑site reactions.

Breaking the limits of existing therapies, even patients with low eosinophil counts benefit. COPD is a progressive lung disease that blocks airflow and causes breathing difficulty, with symptoms such as cough, recurrent chest infections and shortness of breath. It is incurable, but treatment can slow progression. AstraZeneca estimates that 16‑26 million people in the United States have diagnosed or undiagnosed COPD, which is the fifth leading cause of death in the country.

Biologics already approved for COPD include Dupixent, co‑developed by Regeneron (REGN-US) and Sanofi (SNY-US), and Nucala from GlaxoSmithKline (GSK-US), but they are mainly indicated for patients with elevated eosinophil counts. Eosinophils are a type of white blood cell linked to inflammation; current therapies cover only about 30% of COPD patients, leaving roughly 70% with limited or no benefit.

The tozorakimab trials enrolled current and former smokers, patients with varying degrees of lung function impairment, and a range of eosinophil levels. Analyses showed that in patients with eosinophil counts below 150, acute exacerbations fell by 23%; those with counts of 150 or higher saw a 34% reduction, and patients with counts above 300 experienced a 43% drop.

Ruud Dobber, president of AstraZeneca’s biopharma division, said there is currently no biologic available for COPD patients with eosinophil counts below 150, and that tozorakimab’s broad applicability could truly change the treatment paradigm.

Blocking two IL‑33 pathways could drive $5 billion in annual sales. Tozorakimab works by blocking the immune protein IL‑33, which triggers inflammation and mucus production. Other companies’ attempts at anti‑IL‑33 therapies have yielded limited results, including drugs from Sanofi and Roche (RHHBY-US), leading investors to question the potential of this approach.

AstraZeneca believes tozorakimab’s success lies in its ability to inhibit two distinct IL‑33 pathways simultaneously, not only controlling inflammation but also potentially reducing mucus production and airway damage. CEO Pascal Soriot admitted the company originally thought the odds of success were low and that market forecasts had assigned virtually no value to the drug, yet the outcome proved the drug’s efficacy.

AstraZeneca has recently raised its peak‑year sales forecast for tozorakimab to over $5 billion, which could help the company reach its goal of $80 billion in revenue by 2030. The drug is also in phase‑2 trials for severe asthma and phase‑3 trials for severe viral lower‑respiratory‑tract disease, and may later be tested in other IL‑33‑driven conditions such as bronchiectasis.

However, Meilan Han, head of pulmonary and critical care at the University of Michigan Health System, cautioned that because no head‑to‑head trials have compared tozorakimab with Dupixent or Nucala, physicians must still decide which therapy to prioritize for patients with high eosinophil counts. More subgroup analyses will be needed in the future to define its therapeutic positioning.

items.title: 羅賓漢又押中熱門商機！入股Crypto.com搶攻預測市場
items.title_en: Robinhood Strikes Another Hot Deal! Investing in Crypto.com to Attack the Prediction Market
paras: 根據《華爾街日報》周二(8日)報導，羅賓漢(Robinhood Markets)(HOOD-US)宣布與加密貨幣交易所Crypto.com達成多年期合作，將在旗下交易平台引進由Crypto.com預測市場業務OG.com支援的「是或否」事件合約，並取得Crypto.com及OG少數股權，進一步擴大預測市場布局。
雙方未公布協議金額及羅賓漢的投資規模。Crypto.com同時宣布，已將OG分拆為獨立公司。今年7月，城堡證券(Citadel Securities)分別入股Crypto.com與OG後，兩家公司估值各達150億美元及50億美元。
預測市場允許交易者針對選舉、體育賽事或其他事件結果買賣合約，近年迅速受到散戶歡迎，但監管前景仍充滿不確定性。羅賓漢去年已與美國最大預測市場平台Kalshi合作，提供更多種類的事件合約，之後又陸續透過其他合作夥伴擴大業務。
羅賓漢與Susquehanna International Group共同成立的衍生品交易所Rothera，也將事件合約列為業務重點。此次與Crypto.com合作後，羅賓漢表示，可為客戶提供更優惠的價格及更多元的合約選擇。
Crypto.com執行長Kris Marszalek表示，預測市場事件合約只是雙方推出的第一項產品，這段合作關係才剛開始。雙方也曾討論推出與股票連動的永續期貨，但仍須等待監管機關批准。
Crypto.com自2024年底起便透過旗下衍生品部門提供預測市場合約，並於今年2月推出獨立平台OG。Marszalek表示，OG今年業務規模已成長約20倍，與羅賓漢合作可望吸引更多散戶及機構投資人進場，讓機構與散戶交易流量相互匹配。
Crypto.com在2025年底曾與川普媒體科技集團(DJT-US)合作，計畫將預測市場直接整合至Truth Social，但雙方上月以市場環境及商業優先順序改變為由終止合作。
Marszalek透露，Crypto.com接下來將尋求透過併購擴大成長，並正為首次公開募股(IPO)做準備，但尚未決定上市時間。
羅賓漢期貨與預測市場副總裁兼總經理JB Mackenzie表示，美式足球賽季開始，加上秋季期中選舉即將登場，事件合約業務正進入關鍵旺季。此次合作除可滿足客戶需求，也讓羅賓漢在預測市場擁有更直接的利益。
paras_en: According to a Wall Street Journal report on Tuesday the 8th, Robinhood Markets (HOOD-US) announced a multi‑year partnership with cryptocurrency exchange Crypto.com, bringing “yes‑or‑no” event contracts powered by Crypto.com’s prediction‑market business OG.com onto its platform and acquiring minority stakes in Crypto.com and OG to further expand its footprint in the prediction‑market space.

The parties did not disclose the agreement’s monetary value or the size of Robinhood’s investment. Crypto.com also announced that it has spun OG out as an independent company. In July this year, Citadel Securities took stakes in both Crypto.com and OG, valuing the two firms at $15 billion and $5 billion respectively.

Prediction markets let traders buy and sell contracts on the outcomes of elections, sports events or other occurrences. They have surged in popularity with retail investors in recent years, though regulatory outlooks remain uncertain. Robinhood partnered last year with Kalshi, the largest U.S. prediction‑market platform, to offer a broader range of event contracts and has since expanded its offerings through additional partners.

Robinhood’s derivatives exchange Rothera, which it co‑founded with Susquehanna International Group, also lists event contracts as a core product. Following the Crypto.com deal, Robinhood said it can offer customers better pricing and a more diverse selection of contracts.

Crypto.com CEO Kris Marszalek said the event‑contract prediction market is only the first product the two firms will launch together and that the partnership is just getting started. They have also discussed rolling out stock‑linked perpetual futures, pending regulatory approval.

Crypto.com began offering prediction‑market contracts through its derivatives unit at the end of 2024 and launched the standalone OG platform in February this year. Marszalek said OG’s business has grown roughly twenty‑fold in 2023, and the collaboration with Robinhood is expected to draw more retail and institutional investors, matching institutional and retail trading flow.

At the end of 2025 Crypto.com partnered with Trump Media & Technology Group (DJT-US) to integrate prediction markets directly into Truth Social, but the two parties terminated the effort last month citing changes in market conditions and commercial priorities.
Marszalek disclosed that Crypto.com will seek growth through acquisitions and is preparing for an initial public offering, though a listing date has not yet been set.

JB Mackenzie, Robinhood’s vice‑president and general manager of futures and prediction markets, said the start of the NFL season and the upcoming midterm elections signal a peak season for event‑contract business. The partnership not only meets client demand but also gives Robinhood a more direct stake in the prediction‑market ecosystem.

items.title: 威瑞森豪砸數十億美元！康寧成AI光纖大贏家 盤中股價飆逾8%
items.title_en: Verizon Splurges Billions! Corning Becomes AI Fiber Optic Big Winner as Stock Soars Over 8% Intraday
paras: 康寧(GLW-US)周二(8日)盤中飆逾8%，此前電信巨擘威瑞森(VZ-US)宣布與康寧簽署一項價值數十億美元的長期供應協議，將採購超過8,000萬英里高容量光纖，用於擴大全美寬頻網路及建設新一代人工智慧(AI)基礎設施。
截稿前，康寧(GLW-US)盤中股價上漲8.11%，每股暫報166.81美元。
這項協議將持續至2032年。威瑞森表示，康寧提供的光纖除可擴大消費者取得寬頻服務的範圍，也將支援生成式AI的運算需求。公司計畫把地區寬頻、行動通訊與長距離AI基礎設施整合至單一高容量網路，建立能同時服務家庭、企業及AI超大規模雲端業者的融合架構。
威瑞森執行長Kyle Malady表示，取得如此龐大的光纖供應量，將使公司以前所未有的規模建設未來網路。這套統一架構可把行動通訊及寬頻整合成無縫服務，同時打造AI業者所需的高容量、低延遲骨幹網路。
威瑞森股價盤中小跌0.12%，每股暫報50.08美元，其他光通訊類股則走高。Ciena(CIEN-US)漲逾6%%、Coherent(COHR-US)與Lumentum(LITE-US)漲近11%。
隨AI資料中心快速擴張，光纖與光通訊設備日益成為AI投資熱潮的重要環節。康寧近月接連取得科技及電信業者的大型合約，也進一步凸顯其在AI基礎設施供應鏈中的關鍵地位。
康寧今年6月才與亞馬遜(AMZN-US)簽署價值數十億美元的資料中心光纖生產協議。輝達(NVDA-US)5月也宣布向康寧投資最高32億美元，協助其擴充德州與北卡羅來納州的光通訊製造產能；今年1月，康寧另取得Meta Platforms(META-US)價值60億美元的資料中心纜線、光纖及連接解決方案訂單。
康寧7月底公布的第二季獲利優於市場預期，但財測表現令人失望。執行長Wendell Weeks當時表示，公司正邁入成長加速的新階段。此次威瑞森簽下超過8,000萬英里光纖大單，可望進一步強化康寧的營收成長動能。
paras_en: Corning (GLW-US) surged more than 8% during Tuesday’s (the 8th) trading session after telecom giant Verizon (VZ-US) announced it had signed a multi‑billion‑dollar long‑term supply agreement with Corning to purchase over 80 million miles of high‑capacity fiber for expanding its nationwide broadband network and building next‑generation artificial‑intelligence (AI) infrastructure.
By the time of press, Corning’s (GLW-US) intraday price was up 8.11%, briefly reporting $166.81 per share.

The agreement runs through 2032. Verizon said the fiber supplied by Corning will not only broaden consumer access to broadband services but also support the compute demands of generative AI. The company plans to integrate regional broadband, mobile communications and long‑haul AI infrastructure into a single high‑capacity network, creating a converged architecture that can simultaneously serve homes, enterprises and ultra‑large‑scale AI cloud providers.

Verizon CEO Kyle Malady said that securing such a massive fiber supply will enable the company to build the future network at an unprecedented scale. The unified architecture can merge mobile and broadband into a seamless service while delivering the high‑capacity, low‑latency backbone that AI providers require.

Verizon’s stock slipped 0.12% intraday, briefly at $50.08 per share, while other optical‑communications stocks rose. Ciena (CIEN-US) jumped more than 6%, and Coherent (COHR-US) and Lumentum (LITE-US) each climbed close to 11%.

With AI data centers expanding rapidly, fiber and optical‑communication equipment are becoming a key component of the AI investment boom. Corning’s recent string of large contracts with technology and telecom firms further underscores its pivotal role in the AI infrastructure supply chain.

Corning only in June signed a multi‑billion‑dollar data‑center fiber production agreement with Amazon (AMZN-US). In May, Nvidia (NVDA-US) announced an investment of up to $3.2 billion in Corning to help expand its optical‑communication manufacturing capacity in Texas and North Carolina; and in January the company secured a $6 billion order from Meta Platforms (META-US) for data‑center cables, fiber and connectivity solutions.

Corning reported second‑quarter earnings at the end of July that beat market expectations, though its outlook disappointed analysts. CEO Wendell Weeks said the company was entering a new phase of accelerated growth. The massive Verizon order for more than 80 million miles of fiber is expected to further strengthen Corning’s revenue‑growth momentum.

items.title: 日本上次升2碼是37年前！日銀為何這次不願一次下重手？
items.title_en: The BOJ’s Last Two‑Point Rate Hike Was 37 Years Ago – Why It Won’t Take a Big Step This Time
paras: 日銀(日本央行/BOJ)將於9月17日至18日召開決策會議，市場普遍預期將升息1碼(25個基點)，把政策利率從1%調高至1.25%。儘管部分投資人猜測日銀可能一次升息2碼，但知情人士透露，央行幾乎沒有意願採取如此激進的行動，反而傾向「小步快走」，避免為壓制眼前通膨而引爆更大的市場震盪。
日本上一次將主要政策利率一次調高2碼是在1989年，當時正值資產泡沫頂峰，甚至盛傳皇居土地價值超過整個加州房地產總值。泡沫隨後破裂，日本經濟也陷入「失落的十年」。時隔37年，儘管中東衝突、就業市場吃緊及日元疲弱推升進口成本，但目前物價壓力遠不及1980年代。
知情人士表示，如果日銀本月決定升息，最可能採取傳統的1碼幅度，以免衝擊已習慣數十年近零借貸成本的企業、家庭與金融市場，也讓央行有時間觀察過去升息的累積影響。

拒絕一次升2碼 日銀擬改採每季升息

日銀自2024年啟動本輪緊縮循環以來，每次均升息1碼，頻率約為每年兩次。過去決策官員強調，日本經濟歷經近30年通縮，因此貨幣政策正常化必須謹慎；但近來日元大幅貶值加劇物價壓力，促使央行提高警戒。
知情人士指出，日銀正考慮把升息速度加快至約每季一次。換言之，央行可能放棄單次大幅升息，改以更頻繁的小幅調整控制通膨，同時保留後續政策空間。
前日銀官員、現任樂天證券經濟研究所首席經濟學家Nobuyasu Atago表示，一次升息2碼可能被市場解讀為日銀陷入絕望，反而強化央行已落後通膨情勢的疑慮。他預測，日銀本月將升息至1.25%，並於12月或明年1月再升1碼。
日銀審議委員高田創的鷹派言論一度引發大幅升息揣測，但總裁植田和男上周表示，經濟與物價走勢大致符合預測，暗示通膨風險尚未升高到需要採取非常規幅度的程度。植田強調，只要金融環境仍然寬鬆，日銀希望繼續升息，但迄今已調高利率5次，必須審慎評估對經濟的累積影響。

日元升值緩解壓力 中性利率成決策難題

日元兌美元近期升至約153日元的7個月高點，較7月觸及的約164日元、40年低點明顯反彈，也降低日銀透過大幅升息支撐匯率的必要性。多名知情人士指出，近期數據並未顯示通膨急遽加速，既然今年仍有再升息兩次的空間，沒有必要一次用掉2碼。
日本生產者物價近期上升，可能在未來數月推高消費者通膨，但目前幾乎沒有物價與工資失控螺旋上升的跡象。金融環境也仍屬寬鬆，8月銀行放款較去年同期增加5.4%。
不過，隨政策利率逐漸接近日銀估計約1.1%至2.5%的中性利率區間，9人決策委員會中的鴿派成員可能更加謹慎。6月唯一反對升息至1%的審議委員淺田統一郎曾表示，希望看到由需求推動的通膨後才支持升息；另一名鴿派委員佐藤綾乃則主張，央行除物價上行風險外，也必須關注經濟成長下行風險。
野村證券(NMR-US)執行利率策略師Mari Iwashita表示，部分決策委員可能認為市場對升息前景過於積極，預料日銀短期內仍將堅持每次升息1碼。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) will hold its policy‑making meeting on September 17‑18, and the market broadly expects a 25‑basis‑point (one‑point) rate increase, lifting the policy rate from 1.00% to 1.25%. Although some investors speculate the BOJ could raise rates by two points in one go, sources say the central bank has little appetite for such a aggressive move and prefers a “small‑step, fast‑walk” approach to avoid triggering larger market turbulence while trying to curb current inflation.

The last time Japan raised its main policy rate by two points in a single move was in 1989, at the height of the asset‑price bubble, when rumors even claimed the Imperial Palace’s land was worth more than all of California’s real‑estate combined. The bubble burst soon after, plunging the Japanese economy into the “lost decade.” Thirty‑seven years later, despite Middle‑East conflicts, a tightening labor market and a weak yen pushing up import costs, price pressures are far below those of the 1980s.

Sources say that if the BOJ decides to hike rates this month, the most likely move will be the traditional one‑point increase, to avoid shocking corporations, households and financial markets that have grown accustomed to near‑zero borrowing costs for decades, and to give the central bank time to assess the cumulative impact of previous hikes.

Rejecting a Two‑Point Hike, the BOJ Plans Quarterly Increases
Since starting this tightening cycle in 2024, the BOJ has raised rates by one point each time, roughly twice a year. Former policymakers have stressed that Japan has endured nearly 30 years of deflation, so normalising monetary policy must be done cautiously; however, the recent sharp depreciation of the yen has intensified price pressures, prompting the central bank to raise its alert level.

Insiders note the BOJ is considering speeding up the pace of hikes to about once per quarter. In other words, the bank may abandon large, one‑off moves in favour of more frequent, modest adjustments to control inflation while preserving policy space for later.

Former BOJ official and current chief economist at Rakuten Securities, Nobuyasu Atago, said a two‑point hike could be read by the market as a sign that the BOJ is desperate, reinforcing doubts that the central bank is already lagging behind inflation. He predicts the BOJ will raise rates to 1.25% this month and then add another point in December or January of next year.

Hawkish comments from policy‑review member Takada Sou once sparked speculation of a big hike, but Governor Ueda Kazuo said last week that the economy and price trends are broadly in line with expectations, suggesting inflation risks have not risen enough to warrant an unconventional jump. Ueda stressed that as long as the financial environment remains accommodative, the BOJ wants to keep raising rates, but having already lifted rates five times, it must carefully weigh the cumulative impact on the economy.

A stronger yen eases pressure; neutral‑rate estimates complicate decisions
The yen has recently risen to about ¥153 per dollar, a seven‑month high, rebounding from the roughly ¥164 level – a 40‑year low – seen in July, which reduces the need for the BOJ to use a large hike to support the exchange rate. Several sources say recent data do not show a sudden acceleration in inflation, and since there is still room for two more hikes this year, there is no need to use up two points at once.

Japan’s producer‑price index has risen recently and could push consumer inflation higher in the coming months, but there is currently little sign of a wage‑price spiral getting out of control. The financial environment remains accommodative, with bank lending in August up 5.4% year‑on‑year.

However, as the policy rate approaches the BOJ’s estimated neutral‑rate range of roughly 1.1%‑2.5%, the dovish members of the nine‑person policy board may become more cautious. The only member who voted against a hike to 1% in June, Asada Toshikazu, said he wants to see demand‑driven inflation before supporting a hike; another dovish member, Sato Ayano, argued that beyond price‑rise risks, the bank must also watch for downside risks to economic growth.

Nomura Securities (NMR‑US) rate‑strategy analyst Mari Iwashita said some policy members may think the market is overly optimistic about the outlook for hikes, and she expects the BOJ to continue sticking to one‑point increases in the short term.

items.title: 汎瑋8月、前8月營收雙創新高 受惠電子材料應用拓展AI強勁需求
items.title_en: PanWei's August and Year-to-Date Revenues Hit Record Highs, Boosted by Expanding Electronic Materials Applications and Strong AI Demand
paras: 電子機能材料廠汎瑋材料(6967-TW)今(8)日公告8月營收為為13.3億元、月減11.65％、年增1.12％，累計今(2026)年1-8月合併營收達11.05億元，較去年同期大幅成長22.98％。汎瑋表示，延續電子功能性材料在工業電腦及AI伺服器等應用拓展，今年以來強勁的營運成長動能，也帶動8月、前8月合併營收雙雙改寫歷年同期新高。
汎瑋表示，前8月營收主要受惠近年持續深耕高附加價值電子功能性材料解決方案，旗下導電、散熱、電磁屏蔽、絕緣等產品在工業電腦及AI伺服器等終端應用持續拓展，帶動工業電腦及AI伺服器相關產品需求強勁成長，前8月相關終端應用產品營收較去(2025)年同期成長188％。
此外，汎瑋也受惠電動車品牌車廠交車量增加，汽車隔熱紙需求同步提升，亦挹注3M產品經銷業務成長，使電子功能性材料解決方案及經銷業務雙向挹注整體營運，推升前8月營收維持雙位數成長。

汎瑋也觀察到，目前全球AI伺服器需求強勁增長，帶動整體產業鏈進入新一輪升級週期，但同時地緣政治與美國製造政策也正快速改寫全球科技供應鏈版圖，使產業朝向「全球在地化」布局。面對此一趨勢，汎瑋憑「區域供應」的跨國韌性供應網，除了台灣與中國生產基地外，亦持續強化東南亞(越南、馬來西亞)布局，將以靈活的供貨彈性與全球在地化支援能力，成功承接供應鏈轉移帶來的新訂單，主要涵蓋筆記型電腦、智慧家電等應用，預計於今(2026)年第4季末後陸續放量，帶動相關產品出貨與營收貢獻同步提升。
汎瑋表示，隨著客戶持續擴大在亞洲區域的產能配置，公司亦將持續深化全球在地化供應布局，透過多區域生產與供應鏈整合優勢，提升客戶導入意願及長期合作深度，進一步掌握供應鏈移轉所帶來的市場商機。
展望下半年，汎瑋也維持審慎樂觀，除了持續深耕AI伺服器、HPC及智慧家電等既有高階應用市場，汎瑋也將進一步掌握下一波AI硬體升級商機，積極將既有高可靠度、高導熱及EMI防護材料技術延伸至更多新興終端應用，並透過全球在地化供應布局與材料技術整合，加速拓展高附加價值應用市場，優化產品組合與營運結構，以挹注未來整體營運保持穩健成長動能。
paras_en: Electronic functional materials manufacturer PanWei Materials (6967-TW) announced today that August revenue was NT$1.33 billion, down 11.65% month‑over‑month but up 1.12% year‑over‑year. Cumulative consolidated revenue for January‑August 2026 reached NT$11.05 billion, a sharp 22.98% increase from the same period last year. PanWei said that continued expansion of electronic functional materials in industrial computers and AI servers has driven strong operating momentum this year, leading both August and year‑to‑date revenues to set new historical highs for the same months.

PanWei noted that the year‑to‑date revenue benefited from its deepening focus on high‑value‑added electronic functional material solutions. Its conductive, thermal‑management, electromagnetic‑shielding and insulating products have continued to expand in industrial computers and AI servers, spurring robust demand for related products. Revenue from these end‑application segments grew 188% compared with the same period in 2025.

In addition, PanWei gained from the increase in vehicle deliveries by electric‑vehicle brands, which lifted demand for automotive heat‑shield films. This also boosted its 3M product distribution business, allowing both the electronic functional material solutions and distribution channels to feed each other and drive double‑digit year‑to‑date growth.

PanWei observed that global AI‑server demand is rising sharply, pushing the entire supply chain into a new upgrade cycle. At the same time, geopolitical tensions and U.S. manufacturing policies are rapidly reshaping the global tech supply‑chain map, prompting a shift toward “global localization.” To meet this trend, PanWei leverages a resilient, cross‑border supply network – with production bases in Taiwan and China and an expanding footprint in Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Malaysia) – to offer flexible delivery and localized support. It aims to capture new orders from the supply‑chain shift, mainly for notebook computers and smart home appliances, with volumes expected to ramp up after the end of Q4 2026, boosting shipments and revenue contributions.

PanWei said that as customers continue to expand capacity in the Asian region, the company will further deepen its global localized supply layout. By integrating multi‑regional production and supply‑chain advantages, it seeks to increase customer adoption willingness and deepen long‑term cooperation, thereby seizing market opportunities created by supply‑chain transitions.

Looking ahead to the second half of the year, PanWei remains cautiously optimistic. While continuing to deepen its presence in existing high‑end markets such as AI servers, HPC and smart home appliances, the company will also capture the next wave of AI‑hardware upgrade opportunities. It plans to extend its high‑reliability, high‑thermal‑conductivity and EMI‑protection material technologies to more emerging end‑applications, and accelerate growth in high‑value‑added markets through its global localized supply network and material‑technology integration, optimizing its product mix and operating structure to sustain robust growth momentum.

items.title: 中信銀、台壽相繼出手 合計擬砸41億元參與漢測IPO競拍
items.title_en: CTBC Bank and Taiwan Life Successively Move to Bid Up to NT$4.1 Billion in Han Test IPO
paras: 隨著 AI 產業發展，半導體設備廠漢測(7856-TW)近期IPO案掀起市場高度關注，中信金(2891-TW)旗下二大子公司相繼出手，台灣人壽日前核決授權上限20億元參與競拍，中國信託商業銀行今(8)日亦發布公告，經執行長核決通過，擬以自有資金不超過新台幣21億元參與漢測股票競拍，兩家合計投入競拍的資金上限高達 41 億元。
漢民測試系統股份有限公司為國內知名半導體設備與工程服務業者，受惠於AI應用需求強勁帶動整體半導體產業穩健成長，營運前景備受市場關注。漢測預計於9月中旬辦理首次公開發行(IPO)股票競價拍賣，吸引眾多機構法人關注。
根據中信銀行8日發布的公告指出，本次交易標的為漢測普通股，交易決策係依據內部評價及博頌會計師事務所余良元會計師出具之價格合理性意見書進行。中信銀表示，本次投資為依據銀行法相關規定，以銀行自有資金進行財務性投資，參與競拍金額上限為新台幣21億元(不含手續費等)。
在此之前，台灣人壽亦於7日代母公司中信金公告，經內部金融投資總處總處長授權，擬以自有資金上限20億元參與漢測IPO競拍。台灣人壽指出，AI需求崛起帶動半導體市場蓬勃發展，漢測等供應鏈設備廠營運可望持續受惠，因此基於保險資金之長期穩健運用進行布局。
壽險與金融業者近年積極將資金注入半導體及AI相關產業鏈，涵蓋設備服務、封裝測試、散熱等關鍵領域。由於漢測IPO目前尚未開標，中信銀與台灣人壽皆表示，實際取得之股數、每股單位價格與最終交易總金額，均須待正式開標結果確定後再行補充公告。
paras_en: As the AI industry expands, semiconductor equipment maker Han Test (7856‑TW) has drawn strong market interest for its upcoming IPO. CTBC Financial (2891‑TW) sees its two major subsidiaries act in quick succession: Taiwan Life recently approved a NT$20 billion ceiling to join the bid, and China Trust Commercial Bank announced today (the 8th) that, after CEO approval, it intends to use up to NT$21 billion of its own funds to participate, bringing the combined maximum bid amount to NT$41 billion.

Han Min Test Systems Co., Ltd. is a well‑known domestic semiconductor equipment and engineering services provider. Benefiting from robust AI‑driven demand that is bolstering overall semiconductor growth, its operating outlook is attracting market attention. Han Test plans to conduct a book‑building auction for its first‑time public offering in mid‑September, drawing interest from many institutional investors.

According to the announcement released by CTBC Bank on the 8th, the transaction target is Han Test common stock. The investment decision is based on an internal valuation and a price‑reasonableness opinion issued by auditor Yu Liang‑yuan of Boso CPA. CTBC Bank states the investment complies with banking‑law regulations and will be made with its own capital, with a bid ceiling of NT$21 billion (excluding fees).

Earlier, on the 7th, Taiwan Life, on behalf of its parent CTBC Financial, announced that, after authorization from the head of its internal financial investment department, it plans to use up to NT$20 billion of its own funds to join the Han Test IPO bid. Taiwan Life noted that the surge in AI demand is driving vigorous growth in the semiconductor market, and that equipment suppliers like Han Test are likely to continue benefiting, making this a long‑term, stable deployment of insurance capital.

Life insurers and financial firms have recently been actively channeling funds into semiconductor and AI‑related supply chains, covering key areas such as equipment services, packaging and testing, and thermal management. Because the Han Test IPO has not yet been priced, both CTBC Bank and Taiwan Life said the actual number of shares obtained, the per‑share price, and the final transaction amount will be disclosed after the formal auction results are released.

items.title: 主動式ETF正夯，該賣掉0050跳槽嗎？清流君回測打臉：抱超過15年，有8成落後大盤！
paras: 近期台股市場掀起一陣「主動式 ETF」旋風，各大投信紛紛推出標榜「經理人主動選股、汰弱留強、追求超額報酬」的全新商品。看著檔檔吸睛的宣傳文案與短線亮麗的走勢，許多原本堅定持有 0050 等被動市值型 ETF 的投資人，內心不禁開始動搖：
「0050 只會傻傻照市值買，遇到弱勢股也不會砍，是不是落伍了？」
「主動式 ETF 有專業研究團隊操盤，還能靈活避開下市風險，我是不是該把 0050 賣掉，跳槽轉戰主動型商品？」
對於市場上的換股焦慮，長期倡導指數化投資的達人清流君在優分析的《股民想知道》節目中斬釘截鐵地表示：「主動式 ETF 我個人是完全不碰的！因為只要時間拉長，它們的長期績效勢必會落後大盤指數。」
清流君更拿出國際機構研究與台股過去 20 年的本土資料庫回測，用冷靜的數據「打臉」市場熱潮，揭開主動式投資光鮮亮麗背後最殘酷的真相。

一、標普道瓊 SPIVA 報告曝光：短中天期已顯露敗象
很多人以為台灣股市是「散戶多、淺碟型」的市場，主動選股應該很容易打敗大盤。但國際權威機構標普道瓊指數編撰公司（S&P Dow Jones Indices）針對台灣市場長期追蹤的 SPIVA 報告，直接推翻了這個幻想：
專門針對台股大型股的主動型基金進行統計，在過去 5 到 6 年的觀察期間，落後大型指數的比例高達 60% 至 84%！
換言之，即便是由台灣頂尖投信團隊操盤的主動型基金，光是看近 5～6 年的中期成績單，就有六到八成的經理人繳出不如大盤的及格線成績。

二、回測 20 年台股資料庫：拉長到 15 年，逾 8 成打不贏 0050！
為了不讓數據受限於單一週期，清流君親自調閱 TEJ（台灣經濟新報）共同基金資料庫，進行了一場跨越 20 年（涵蓋約 370 檔台股主動基金）的終極回測。

關鍵：必須把「倖存者偏誤」加進去！
清流君特別強調，很多機構的績效統計會「美化」數據，因為他們只看目前還活著的基金。「這就像看見幾家創業成功的富豪，就斷言創業百分之百會發大財一樣荒謬！」
在這項回測中，清流君將過去十幾年間被清算、倒閉、合併、下市的台股基金通通保留在分母中，以各期期末往回推算，與 0050（含息再投入）進行對決：
持有 3 年至 10 年： 主動基金贏過 0050 的機率大約是 50% 左右（一半一半）。這也是為什麼主動式 ETF 剛推出 3～5 年時最容易吸金，因為此時看似還有一半的經理人能跑贏大盤。
拉長至 15 年、20 年： 勝率呈現雪崩式暴跌！能戰勝 0050 的主動基金只剩下 10%～20% 左右。
這項歷史鐵證告訴我們：只要抱得夠久（超過 15 年），有高達 80% 到 90% 的主動型基金都會被 0050 狠狠甩在後頭！

三、散戶最愛犯的致命大忌：「看過去排行榜挑基金」
「那我不買隨便的主動基金，我專挑過去 3 年或 5 年績效排名前 3 名、前 5 名的『神仙經理人』總可以了吧？」
針對投資人這種常見的僥倖心理，清流君引用美國經典研究方法，統計了 2007 年至 2025 年底的真實數據：
將市場上的基金依過去 3 年績效切分為：贏家組（前 10%）、中間組與輸家組（倒數 10%）。
每組以等權重配置持有 3 年（含息再投入），再拿去跟 0050 比較。
回測結果出現了極度諷刺的一幕：
贏家組依然輸給大盤： 過去 3 年績效最強的前 10% 贏家基金，雖然表現優於中間組與輸家組，但累積總績效依舊落後給 0050！
被唾棄的「輸家組」居然沒差多少： 過去被投資人罵到臭頭、績效墊底的輸家組，如果在後續持續持有，長期年化報酬竟然與贏家組非常接近。
清流君警告：看過去績效去挑主動式 ETF，是投資世界中最危險的「後見之明偏誤（Hindsight Bias）」！ 你誤以為自己找到了事前答案，但實際上你只是選中了一個「剛好在過去 3 年押對行情的幸運兒」，而市場的均值回歸很快就會讓超額報酬消失殆盡。

四、主動型 ETF 為何注定難以擊敗大盤？
為什麼主動型基金與主動式 ETF 隨著時間拉長，績效幾乎必然劣化？核心原因有三：
高昂的內扣摩擦成本： 主動型商品通常收取較高的經理費、保管費與換股周轉交易成本，經理人每年還沒開跑，就先落後大盤 1%～2% 的起跑線。
經理人的風格漂移與更換： 神級經理人可能跳槽、退休，或是其擅長的投資風格（如小型成長股）不再受市場青睞。
零和賽局的殘酷現實： 市場上的機構法人越來越多，所有頂尖大腦彼此競爭扣除手續費後，整體主動資金的平均回報在數學上必然低於市場整體指數。

五、什麼樣的人才能買主動式 ETF？
難道主動式 ETF 真的完全一無是處嗎？清流君給出明確界線：
可以買的情境： 除非你深入研究過該經理人團隊超過 10 年以上的完整操盤經歷，並且你具備堅定不移的信念，相信他在未來 10 到 20 年都能持續打破「8成落後」的統計鐵律，那你可以考慮支持。
絕對不要買的情境： 如果你是抱著**「賭一把」、「看最近很紅想賺波段短線」、「把它當個股在追高殺低」**的心態進場，那麼歷史數據證明，你大概率只會成為繳納高額管理費的韭菜。

結論：不要被行銷包裝迷惑，堅守 0050 才是致勝大道
「最好的投資方式，往往也是最無聊的方式。」
看著滿天飛舞的主動式 ETF 廣告與華麗文案，投資人切莫患了 FOMO（害怕錯過）的毛病。回測 20 年的血淋淋數據已經證明：時間是被動指數投資最好的朋友，卻是主動選股最大的敵人。
如果你手頭握著 0050 或 006208，根本不需要費盡心思換股跳槽。繼續無視市場噪音，將資金穩穩地放在市值型大盤 ETF 裡，「無腦 All-in、長期持有、捏緊捏爆」，你就能輕鬆擊敗市場上 80% 以上忙進忙出的主動選股專家！

items.title: 〈台塑四寶業績〉「金九銀十」旺季+電子材料產能趨滿載 台塑、南亞看好Q4業績更亮眼
items.title_en: Formosa Plastics' Four-Product Business: "Golden September, Silver October" Peak Season and Near‑Full Capacity in Electronic Materials; Formosa and Nan Ya Expect Even Brighter Q4 Results
paras: 台塑(1301-TW)四寶今日自結8月營收，展望今(2026)年3、4季業績，台塑認為，中東衝突持續反覆不定，在原油期貨價格居高不下，第3季營業額低於第2季，但9月中國進入石化「金九銀十」旺季，加上開工率及產銷量提高下，估計第4季業績將高於第3季。南亞(1301-TW)則持續受惠AI硬體推陳出新，電子材料進入成長起飛期，估第3、4季業績優於第2季，未來逐季轉佳。
台塑表示，第3季因8月配合台塑化(6505-TW)OL-3歲修，9月恢復正常生產，預期產量比8月增加，雖然第3季中油及台塑化乙烯、丙烯供給量增加，本公司開工率及產銷量提高，但美伊戰爭反覆，原油價格上下震盪，客戶購料心態保守，影響石化行情，第3季營業額略低於第2季，但第3季因有現金股利11億元，以及台塑美國公司換股利益約13億元入帳，有望挹注獲利。
針對第4季旺季，台塑表示，在中東持續升溫，讓原油價格居高不下，帶動乙烯、丙烯價格上漲，也誘發下游客戶「買漲不買跌」的補庫存行情，短期石化產品價格呈現震盪偏強走勢，但若美伊衝突持續延長擴大，中東石化產品物流受阻，有利推升亞洲石化產品價格。
台塑也指出，公司在第4季開工率為75％將高於第3季65％，預期第4季營業額高於第3季。
南亞則表示，第3季電子材料營運正進入成長起飛期，是公司營收成長的主要動力，加上把握乙二醇外銷市場利差，增開產線，貢獻營收，預期9月營收較8月成長，第3季較第2季暨去(2025)年同期增加，第4季營收也有望較第3季逐季成長。
南亞強調，第3、4季產品持續因業界看好AI算力規模，於未來幾年內仍會大幅成長，讓產業鏈相關業者持續推進資本支出，且預期邊緣運算將帶動終端電子產品的升級需要，可望驅動各類電子材料產品營收成長，目前南亞電子材料各產線產能利用率已趨近滿載，除新廠擴建案以外，也積極執行短期產能提升措施。
南亞表示，在產能布局上，已針對銅箔基板廠進行製程優化，並在兩岸增設一定數量的特殊玻纖紡位，另新增的玻纖布織機也將陸續到位，上述短期措施預計可於今年第4季至明(2027)年起開始貢獻產能及營收，有利於即時掌握商機。
南亞也說，除了AI電子材料，公司在塑膠加工近年運用深厚加工技術，開發出新用途、新材質等整合性產品，近年來致力於市場拓展布局、技術紮根等，已在最近的高階產品認證看到良好成果，進程順利且數據表現優異，待放量後，對營運將會有長期貢獻。
台化(1326-TW)則表示，隨油價持續攀升，預期化工產品及塑料全部跟漲，加上夏天高溫及假期結束，預期9 月份營收會比8 月份改善，中東衝突應會持續一段時間，短時間不易解決，預期油價將維持高位震盪，第3季受原油波動及淡季影響，本業經營不如預期，但原油維持高位，權益法投資收入將有所挹注。
paras_en: Formosa Plastics (1301‑TW) reported its August revenue today and looked ahead to its performance in the third and fourth quarters of 2026. The company said that the ongoing, unpredictable Middle‑East conflict keeps crude oil futures prices high, resulting in third‑quarter sales lower than the second quarter. However, September marks China’s petrochemical "golden September, silver October" peak season, and with higher plant utilization and sales volumes, Formosa expects fourth‑quarter results to exceed those of the third quarter. Nan Ya (1301‑TW) continues to benefit from the rapid rollout of AI hardware, putting its electronic materials business into a growth‑take‑off phase, and forecasts that both Q3 and Q4 will outperform Q2, with performance improving quarter by quarter.

Formosa noted that the third quarter was affected by an August shutdown at its Formosa Chemicals (6505‑TW) OL‑3 unit for a three‑year overhaul. Production resumed to normal in September, and output is expected to rise versus August. Although ethylene and propylene supplies from CPC and Formosa Chemicals increased and the company’s plant utilization and sales volumes rose, the back‑and‑forth US‑Iran war caused crude price volatility and made customers more cautious in purchasing, dampening petrochemical market sentiment. Consequently, third‑quarter revenue was slightly lower than the second quarter, but the quarter includes a cash dividend of NT$1.1 billion and a share‑exchange gain of about NT$1.3 billion from Formosa’s U.S. subsidiary, which should boost earnings.

Regarding the fourth‑quarter peak season, Formosa said that the continued heating of the Middle East keeps crude prices elevated, driving up ethylene and propylene prices and prompting downstream customers to “buy the rise, not the fall,” restocking inventories. In the short term, petrochemical product prices are expected to remain volatile but on the stronger side. If the US‑Iran conflict persists or expands, logistics disruptions in the Middle East could further lift Asian petrochemical prices.
Formosa also pointed out that its plant utilization is projected at 75 % in Q4, up from 65 % in Q3, and it expects fourth‑quarter revenue to be higher than the third quarter.

Nan Ya said its electronic materials business is entering a growth‑take‑off period in Q3, becoming the main driver of revenue growth. By capitalizing on price differentials in the ethylene glycol export market and adding new production lines, the company contributed to higher sales and expects September revenue to grow versus August. Revenue in Q3 should exceed Q2 and also be higher than the same period in 2025, with Q4 revenue likely to grow sequentially from Q3.

Nan Ya emphasized that product demand in Q3 and Q4 will continue to rise as the industry remains optimistic about AI compute scale, which is expected to grow substantially over the next few years. This outlook encourages upstream players to increase capital spending, and edge computing is projected to drive upgrades in end‑user electronic products, boosting sales across all electronic‑material categories. Currently, utilization rates across Nan Ya’s electronic‑material lines are approaching full capacity; beyond new plant expansions, the company is actively implementing short‑term capacity‑increase measures.

Nan Ya added that, in terms of capacity layout, it has optimized processes at its copper‑foil substrate plants and added a certain number of special glass‑fiber spinning stations on both sides of the Taiwan Strait. New glass‑fiber weaving machines will also be installed gradually. These short‑term actions are expected to start contributing to capacity and revenue from Q4 of this year through 2027, helping the company capture market opportunities promptly.

Nan Ya also noted that, besides AI‑related electronic materials, the company has leveraged its deep plastic‑processing expertise in recent years to develop integrated products with new uses and new materials. It has been focusing on market expansion and technology consolidation, achieving strong results in recent high‑end product certifications. The progress is smooth and performance data are excellent; once scaled up, these initiatives are expected to provide long‑term contributions to operations.

Formosa Chemicals (1326‑TW) said that with oil prices continuing to rise, it expects all chemical and plastic products to follow suit. Combined with high summer temperatures and the end of holidays, the company anticipates September revenue to improve over August. The Middle‑East conflict is likely to persist for some time and will not be resolved quickly, keeping oil prices in a high‑level fluctuation. The third quarter was affected by oil‑price volatility and a seasonal slowdown, resulting in operating performance below expectations, but sustained high oil prices and equity‑method investment income should provide a boost.

items.title: 存放款+財管發威！彰銀前8月獲利155億年增23.21%再創新高 EPS 1.29元
items.title_en: Deposits and Wealth Management Drive Growth! Chang Hwa Bank Posts NT$15.5 B Profit for Jan‑Aug, Up 23.21% YoY, New High EPS NT$1.29
paras: 公股行庫獲利表現持續亮眼，彰銀(2801-TW)率先公布8月自結合併稅後純益20.75億元，年增29%，累計前8月稅後純益達155.67億元，年增23.21%，每股稅後盈餘(EPS)為1.29元。受惠存放款與財富管理業務動能強勁，利息與手續費淨收益顯著貢獻，帶動整體獲利表現亮眼。
彰銀115年8月份自結合併稅前盈餘24.24億元，合併稅後純益20.75億元，年成長率高達29.16%；累計前8月合併稅前盈餘179.46億元，年增18.65%，累計合併稅後純益155.67億元，年增23.21%，營運成長動能充沛。
彰銀近年持續深化「雙翅膀」策略，以「展翅高飛、再創新局」為主軸，推動企業金融與個人金融雙軌並進，有效多元化收益來源，大幅提升非利息收入比重，進而帶動各項核心業務與資產規模持續擴張。面對全球經濟環境變化，彰銀積極強化資產品質及風險管理，展現極佳獲利韌性。憑藉穩健財務體質、獲利成長動能及卓越永續治理，彰銀近日更獲得國際法人投資青睞，勇奪「2026外資精選台灣金融10強」殊榮。
在深化核心業務之際，彰銀亦積極拓展信託服務版圖，近期攜手統一投信，為大三億營造量身打造員工福利儲蓄信託，透過員工儲蓄與企業提撥雙軌機制，結合不同風險屬性的投資組合，協助企業完善員工福利制度，並讓員工同步累積長期財富，實現「企業留才、員工留財」的雙贏目標。
此外，彰銀持續深化永續金融、氣候風險管理及公司治理，並透過綠色授信及永續金融服務支持企業低碳轉型，相關成果近年屢獲國內外專業機構肯定，在追求營運成長的同時，也持續強化永續經營與長期競爭力。
彰銀表示，未來將持續以「雙翅膀獲利模式」強化成長動能，一方面提升利差與資金運用效益，另一方面擴大財富管理與手續費收入，並深化企業金融、海外布局、數位轉型與信託服務等多元業務，兼顧業務成長、資產品質與風險管理，持續提升獲利品質與經營韌性。
paras_en: State-owned banks continue to shine in profitability, and Chang Hwa Bank (2801‑TW) was the first to announce its August consolidated after‑tax net profit of NT$20.75 billion, up 29% year‑over‑year. For the first eight months of the year, consolidated after‑tax net profit reached NT$155.67 billion, a 23.21% increase from a year earlier, with earnings per share (EPS) of NT$1.29. Strong momentum from deposit taking and wealth‑management businesses boosted net interest and fee income, driving the impressive overall profit performance.

In August 2023, Chang Hwa Bank reported consolidated pre‑tax earnings of NT$24.24 billion and after‑tax net profit of NT$20.75 billion, a year‑over‑year growth of 29.16%. For the cumulative January‑August period, consolidated pre‑tax earnings totaled NT$179.46 billion, up 18.65% YoY, and consolidated after‑tax net profit was NT$155.67 billion, up 23.21%, reflecting robust operational growth momentum.

In recent years, Chang Hwa Bank has deepened its “Two‑Wing” strategy, centered on “spreading wings and creating new opportunities,” advancing both corporate and retail finance in tandem. This diversification has markedly increased the share of non‑interest income, fueling expansion of core businesses and asset scale. Facing a shifting global economic landscape, the bank is strengthening asset quality and risk management, demonstrating strong profit resilience. Backed by solid financial fundamentals, growth momentum and excellent ESG governance, Chang Hwa Bank was recently honored with the “2026 Foreign‑Investor Selected Top 10 Taiwan Financial Institutions” award.

While deepening its core operations, Chang Hwa Bank is also expanding its trust‑service footprint. It recently partnered with Uni-President Asset Management to create a tailor‑made employee‑benefit savings trust for a NT$300 million program, combining employee savings and corporate contributions with diversified risk‑profile investment portfolios. The initiative helps firms enhance employee benefit schemes while allowing staff to build long‑term wealth, achieving a win‑win of “retaining talent for the company and wealth for employees.”

Moreover, Chang Hwa Bank continues to advance sustainable finance, climate‑risk management and corporate governance, supporting corporate low‑carbon transitions through green lending and sustainable‑finance services. Its achievements have repeatedly earned recognition from domestic and international professional bodies, reinforcing sustainable operations and long‑term competitiveness alongside business growth.

The bank says it will keep strengthening growth drivers through its “Two‑Wing profit model,” boosting net interest margins and fund‑utilization efficiency on one side, while expanding wealth‑management and fee‑based income on the other. It will also deepen corporate finance, overseas expansion, digital transformation and trust services, balancing business growth, asset quality and risk management to continuously improve profit quality and operational resilience.

items.title: 台灣大林之晨：若成功完成精誠公開收購 明年營收挑戰電信一哥
items.title_en: Taiwan Dali's Lin: If the Public Tender for Jingcheng Succeeds, Next Year's Revenue Could Challenge Telecom Leader
paras: 台灣大(3045-TW)三大事業成長動能延續，加上近期以公開收購方式提高精誠資訊(6214-TW)持股至少39%，總經理林之晨今(8)日指出，若後續成功完成對精誠的公開收購，明年營收有機會挑戰超越中華電信(2412-TW)。
台灣大先前於法說會上修全年獲利展望，合併利益成長上修至7到9%，其中，電信業務營業利益則上調為13至15%，合併營益率上調至10至12%，合併營收則維持先前看法。
林之晨表示，此次上調獲利獲利展望並未包含精誠的收購案，仍需看後續收購案是否通過，包括能否達成39%的門檻，以及公平會是否核准，且案子通過後，還要進行董事會改選才會併表，時間點可能落在今年底或明年。不過他也提到，若後續公開收購完成，可望挹注整體營運，營收明年有機會挑戰超越中華電信。
企業服務事業商務長朱曉幸也針對企業事業說明，指出今年企業事業營運表現超乎預期，主要動力來自AI需求，首先是AI與資安，包括基礎的AIDC與相關應用，今年也看到碳盤查與能源管理商機；第二則是AI帶動大頻寬連線需求，推升企業語音業務成長，也刺激電信本業業績。
朱曉幸進一步指出，企業事業第一季成長26%、第二季成長19%，預期第三季將維持成長20%的態勢。
林之晨表示，今年企業事業營收已成長20%，是超標達成，也進一步推升整體營收成長4%。另外，預期今年電信本業維持3%上下的成長幅度，科技事業則成長4至5%。
paras_en: Taiwan D (3045‑TW) sees continued growth momentum across its three major businesses, and after recently increasing its stake in Jingcheng Information (6214‑TW) to at least 39% through a public tender, General Manager Lin Chih‑Chen said today (the 8th) that if the tender for Jingcheng is successfully completed, next year’s revenue could have a chance to surpass Chunghwa Telecom (2412‑TW).

Taiwan D previously revised its full‑year profit outlook at its earnings conference, raising consolidated profit growth to 7‑9%, with telecom operating profit lifted to 13‑15%, consolidated operating margin raised to 10‑12%, while keeping its prior view on consolidated revenue.

Lin noted that the upward revision of profit outlook does not include the Jingcheng acquisition, which still depends on whether the tender clears the 39% threshold and receives antitrust approval. Even if approved, a board election would be required before consolidation, likely occurring at the end of this year or next. He added that completing the public tender could inject strength into overall operations, giving next year’s revenue a chance to overtake Chunghwa Telecom.

Enterprise Services Business Vice President Zhu Hsiao‑Hsing explained that this year’s enterprise segment performed beyond expectations, driven mainly by AI demand—firstly AI and cybersecurity, including basic AIDC and related applications, as well as emerging carbon‑footprint auditing and energy‑management opportunities; secondly, AI spurs high‑bandwidth connectivity needs, boosting enterprise voice services and stimulating the core telecom business.
Zhu further noted that the enterprise segment grew 26% in Q1 and 19% in Q2, and is expected to maintain about 20% growth in Q3.

Lin said the enterprise segment’s revenue has already grown 20% this year, exceeding targets and contributing an additional 4% to overall revenue growth. He also expects the core telecom business to grow roughly 3% this year, while the technology segment should expand 4‑5%.

items.title: 問就是正2？年化35%超狂！清流君警告：1,000萬恐暴跌只剩100萬，你真捏得住？
items.title_en: Is It Really a 2x? Annualized 35% Insane! Clean Stream Warns: 10 Million Could Plummet to 1 Million, Can You Hold On?
paras: 台股在大多頭行情的推升下屢創歷史新高，市場投資熱度沸騰。除了主動式 ETF 掀起話題，另一檔被無數股民奉為「財富密碼」的標的，正是槓桿型 ETF——元大台灣50正2（00631L）。
「既然長期看好台股持續向上，那何必只買一倍的 0050？問就是 All-in 正 2 啊！」這樣的聲音充斥各大投資論壇。統計至 8 月底，正 2 單日成交金額甚至一度衝破 61.9 億元，與 0050 旗鼓相當。
然而，正 2 真的能當作「無腦長抱、養老致富」的神器嗎？被動投資達人清流君在優分析的《股民想知道》節目中以詳實數據直言：正 2 的年化報酬率確實狂暴，但在享受甜美果實之前，你必須先問自己，能否承受「資產蒸發逾八成、1,000 萬縮水到只剩 170 萬」的滅頂試煉？

一、年化報酬率 35.89%！正 2 過去 10 年的「致富神話」
回顧過去 10 多年，正 2 的表現確實讓人瞠目結舌。
從 2014 年 10 月底成立至今年 7 月底的數據回測：
0050（原型一倍）： 年化報酬率高達 20.5%（這成績甚至超越了巴菲特的長期平均水準）。
正 2（00631L）： 年化報酬率更是狂飆至 35.89%！
如果投資人在 2014 年投入 100 萬元並持續持有正 2，這筆資產至今已翻了數倍。這段期間，正 2 不僅跑贏 0050，更是狠狠拉開了巨大的財富差距。
但清流君強調：正 2 之所以能繳出這種神級表現，是因為台股過去 10 年剛好處於「超級大牛市」的單邊強多頭格局中。 很多人只看到正 2 賺錢時的乘數效應，卻完全忽視了它內部機制的「致命暗器」。

二、每天都在「追高殺低」？正 2 的每日再平衡機制大解密
正 2 之所以具備兩倍槓桿，靠的不是經理人神奇的操盤技術，而是每天收盤時機械式的「每日再平衡（Daily Rebalancing）」。
為了讓基金每天的總曝險維持在淨值的「2 倍」，經理人必須進行以下操作：

情境 A：大盤單日上漲 10%（漲後加碼）
假設正 2 原始淨值為 100 元，2 倍曝險就是 200 元。當指數大漲 10%，總曝險增加到 220 元，此時 ETF 淨值賺了 20 元變成 120 元。
這時的槓桿比例變成：220÷120=1.83倍 (低於目標2倍)
經理人動作： 必須在市場上「機械式加碼」買進 20 元的部位，將總曝險拉到 240 元，以回復 2 倍槓桿。

情境 B：大盤單日下跌 10%（跌後減碼）
同樣的 100 元淨值、200 元曝險，當指數下跌 10%，總曝險降到 180 元，淨值賠了 20 元變成 80 元。
這時的槓桿比例變成：180÷80＝2.25倍 (超過目標 2 倍，槓桿過大)
經理人動作： 必須在當天收盤「被迫賣出減碼」20 元部位，將曝險降至 160 元，才能讓槓桿比例回到 2 倍。

兩面刃效應：趨勢盤是「正向複利」，震盪盤成「波動耗損」
清流君點出盲點：「你有沒有發現？漲後加碼、跌後減碼，換成白話文其實就是『追高殺低』！」
多頭順風時（正向複利）： 股市一路上漲，今天買、明天再漲再買，追高加碼的部位享受更大漲幅，讓報酬率遠超 2 倍。
區間盤整時（波動耗損）： 當股市今天漲、明天跌、後天又漲，正 2 就會不斷上演「高檔買進、低檔砍倉」的循環，即便大盤指數最終原地踏步，正 2 的淨值也會被這種摩擦成本「默默吃乾抹淨」。

三、歷史殘酷回測：最大跌幅 -83%，資產瞬間剩 170 萬！
「如果將來台股不再是一路不回頭的瘋牛，而是遇上漫長的盤整甚至大崩盤呢？」清流君調閱了正 2 成立前（2003 年 6 月底至 2014 年 10 月底）的歷史資料，以每日還原股價模擬出一段長達 11 年的正 2 歷史回測：
數據顯示，正 2 最終雖然仍以 11.92% 贏過 0050 的 8.67%，但代價極其慘烈：
波動度放大到 43%： 你的心跳會隨著每天動輒 5%～10% 的帳面跳動而瀕臨崩潰。
資產直接蒸發 83%： 在 2008 年金融海嘯期間，持有 0050 的人資產腰斬（-55%）；但如果你抱的是正 2，原本的 1,000 萬資產將會眼睜睜跌到只剩 170 萬元！
更殘酷的還在後頭。如果我們截取 2003 年中到 2012 年中這長達 9 年的區間，回測結果顯示：正 2 與 0050 的累積報酬率最終「完全打平」！
這意味著，你整整忍受了 9 年如坐大怒神般的心理折磨，經歷了資產狂跌 83% 的絕望，最後的獲利竟然跟躺平抱著 0050 的人一模一樣。

四、問問自己的內心：你真的「捏得住」嗎？
清流君直言，很多股民在看歷史回測線圖時，往往覺得「跌下去反正還會漲回來，我有什麼好怕的？捏緊捏爆就對了！」
但真實的人性往往不是如此：
當你的 1,000 萬在短短幾個月內縮水成 500 萬、300 萬，最後在底部只剩下 170 萬時，身邊充斥著「世界末日、經濟大蕭條、台股要崩到歸零」的恐慌言論。
絕大多數自稱能「長期投資」的人，往往就在這個最絕望的時刻繳械投降，直接把資產「砍在阿呆谷」，從此徹底畢業，再也吃不到後續多頭翻倍的利潤。

總結：正 2 到底能不能買？清流君給出關鍵解答
對於正 2，清流君並非全然否定。事實上，在時間拉長至 20 年、30 年，且整體市場長期向上的經濟規律下，正 2 戰勝原型的勝率確實較高。
但你是否適合把錢放進正 2？端看你符合哪一種條件：
千萬別碰正 2 的人：
想把正 2 當作短線波段操作工具的人。
沒有看過自己資產大幅回撤、心臟偏小顆的小資族或退休族。
只要帳面虧損 30% 就會失眠、想停損的人。
建議：回歸 0050 或 006208，雖然少賺一點，但睡得著覺才走得遠。
可以考慮正 2 的人：
距離退休還有 20～30 年以上、擁有極大現金流可持續投入的年輕投資人。
充分理解每日再平衡原理，明白「盤整會耗損、暴跌會腰斬再腰斬」的底層架構。
擁有鋼鐵般的紀律，當 1,000 萬跌到剩 100 萬時，不僅不會在阿呆谷恐慌割肉，還能嚴格遵守原則、徹底「捏緊捏爆」留在市場的人。
「投資不是比誰在順風時賺得最多，而是比誰在大風大浪中活得最久。」 面對年化 35% 的魔鬼誘惑，進場前務必先惦惦自己的斤兩——那張通往財富自由的入場券，是用心驚膽跳與極致回撤的代價換來的！

paras_en: Taiwan stocks have repeatedly hit historic highs under a strong bull market, heating up market investment enthusiasm. Besides active ETFs sparking discussion, another target revered by countless retail investors as a “wealth code” is the leveraged ETF—Yuanta Taiwan 50 Bull 2 (00631L).

“If you’re bullish on Taiwan stocks long‑term, why settle for the 1x 0050? Just go All‑in on Bull 2!” Such voices flood investment forums. By the end of August, Bull 2’s single‑day trading volume even surged past NT$6.19 billion, rivaling the 0050.

But can Bull 2 really be the “set‑and‑forget, retirement‑riches” magic tool? Passive‑investment guru Clean Stream bluntly stated on You Analysis’s “What Investors Want to Know” program, backed by detailed data: Bull 2’s annualized return is indeed ferocious, but before tasting the sweet fruit you must ask yourself whether you can endure a “asset evaporation of over 80%, a NT$10 million drop to just NT$1.7 million” trial by fire?
1. Annualized Return 35.89%—Bull 2’s “Wealth‑Making Myth” Over the Past Decade The performance of Bull 2 over the past ten‑plus years is truly eye‑catching.
From its inception at the end of October 2014 to the end of July this year, back‑tested data shows:
0050 (the 1x prototype): Annualized return as high as 20.5% (even surpassing Warren Buffett’s long‑term average).
Bull 2 (00631L): Annualized return skyrocketed to 35.89%!

If an investor had put NT$1 million into Bull 2 in 2014 and held it continuously, the asset would have multiplied several times by now. During that period Bull 2 not only outperformed the 0050 but also widened the wealth gap dramatically.

Clean Stream emphasizes that Bull 2’s god‑like performance stems from the fact that Taiwan’s market was in a “super bull” one‑sided strong uptrend for the past ten years. Many only see the multiplier effect when Bull 2 makes money, completely ignoring its internal “deadly hidden weapon.”

2. Daily “Buy High, Sell Low”? Bull 2’s Daily Rebalancing Mechanism Unveiled Bull 2’s 2× leverage isn’t due to any wizardry by the manager but to a mechanical “Daily Rebalancing” performed at each market close.
To keep the fund’s total exposure at twice its net asset value, the manager must execute the following actions:

Scenario A: Market rises 10% in a day (add‑on after rise) Assume Bull 2’s original NAV is 100 NT$, 2× exposure equals 200 NT$. When the index jumps 10%, total exposure rises to 220 NT$, and the ETF’s NAV gains 20 NT$ to become 120 NT$.
The leverage ratio now is 220÷120=1.83× (below the target 2×).
Manager’s action: Mechanically buy an additional 20 NT$ position in the market, raising total exposure to 240 NT$ to restore the 2× leverage.
Scenario B: Market falls 10% in a day (reduce after fall) With the same 100 NT$ NAV and 200 NT$ exposure, a 10% drop cuts total exposure to 180 NT$, and the NAV loses 20 NT$ to become 80 NT$.
The leverage ratio now is 180÷80=2.25× (exceeding the target 2×, leverage too high).
Manager’s action: At market close, forcibly sell 20 NT$ of holdings, lowering exposure to 160 NT$ so the leverage returns to 2×.

Double‑edged effect: Trend markets yield “positive compounding,” while choppy markets cause “volatility decay.” Clean Stream points out the blind spot: “Did you notice? Adding after a rise and cutting after a fall is basically ‘buy high, sell low’ in plain language!”
In a bullish ride (positive compounding): the market keeps climbing, you buy today, buy more tomorrow as it rises further, and the added positions ride larger gains, delivering returns far beyond 2×.

In a ranging market (volatility decay): when the market goes up one day, down the next, up again the day after, Bull 2 repeatedly executes “buy high, cut low” cycles. Even if the index ends up flat, Bull 2’s NAV is silently eroded by these friction costs.

3. Harsh Historical Back‑Test: Max Drawdown ‑83%, Asset Shrinks to NT$1.7 million! “What if Taiwan’s market stops its relentless bull run and enters a prolonged consolidation or a major crash?” Clean Stream retrieved data from before Bull 2’s launch (June 2003 to October 2014) and simulated an 11‑year historical back‑test by reconstructing daily prices:
The data shows that Bull 2 ultimately still beat the 0050 (11.92% vs 8.67%) but at a terrible cost:
Volatility amplified to 43%: your heart will race as daily paper gains swing 5%‑10%, pushing you toward collapse.
Asset evaporated 83%: during the 2008 financial crisis, 0050 holders saw their assets halve (‑55%); but if you held Bull 2, a NT$10 million position would have plummeted to just NT$1.7 million!
Even worse, slicing the period from mid‑2003 to mid‑2012 (a nine‑year stretch) the back‑test shows Bull 2’s cumulative return ended up “exactly flat” with the 0050’s!
That means you would have endured nine years of relentless psychological torment, watched an 83% asset plunge, and in the end earned the same as someone who simply held the 0050.

4. Ask Your Heart: Can You Really “Hold Tight”? Clean Stream bluntly notes that many retail investors, when looking at historical back‑test charts, think “It will bounce back anyway, why be scared? Just grip tighter!”
But real human nature is often different:

When your NT$10 million shrinks to NT$5 million, then NT$3 million, and finally only NT$1.7 million at the bottom, panic talk about “the end of the world, a massive economic depression, Taiwan stocks crashing to zero” floods your surroundings.

The vast majority of self‑proclaimed “long‑term investors” surrender at this most desperate moment, cutting their assets “in the dumb valley,” graduating forever from the market and never again catching the next bullish double‑up profit.

Summary: Should You Buy Bull 2? Clean Stream’s Key Answer For Bull 2, Clean Stream isn’t outright dismissive. In fact, over a 20‑ or 30‑year horizon under a generally upward‑trending economy, Bull 2’s odds of beating its 1× counterpart are indeed higher.
But whether you should put money into Bull 2 depends on which of the following conditions you meet:
People who should absolutely stay away from Bull 2:
Those who want to use Bull 2 as a short‑term swing‑trading tool.
Small‑cap or retiree investors who have never seen a large drawdown and have a weak heart.
Anyone who loses sleep and wants to stop loss at a 30% paper loss.
Recommendation: revert to 0050 or 006208; you’ll earn a bit less, but you’ll sleep soundly and go farther.
People who may consider Bull 2:
Investors with 20‑30 years or more until retirement, possessing ample cash flow to keep investing continuously.
Those who fully understand the daily rebalancing principle and grasp that “consolidation erodes, crashes halve and halve again” at the core level.

Investors with steel‑like discipline who, when NT$10 million drops to NT$1 million, won’t panic‑sell in the “dumb valley” but strictly stick to the plan, “gripping tight and exploding” while staying in the market.

“Investing isn’t about who makes the most in smooth sailing, but who survives the biggest storms the longest.” Facing a devilish 35% annualized lure, be sure to weigh your own capacity before entering— that ticket to financial freedom costs heart‑pounding focus and extreme drawdowns.

items.title: 非農強勁也無感！美國家庭財務惡化、失業率預期創逾6年新高
items.title_en: Strong Nonfarm Payrolls Still Unfelt: US Household Finances Worsen, Unemployment Rate Outlook Hits Over Six-Year High
paras: 紐約聯準銀行周二(8日)公布的8月消費者預期調查顯示，美國家庭對個人財務及整體就業市場的看法轉趨悲觀。儘管通膨預期大致穩定，愈來愈多受訪者認為自身財務狀況已經惡化，並擔心未來一年失業率上升。
調查顯示，認為家庭財務狀況較一年前「差很多」或「差一些」的受訪者占比，從7月的37.6%升至38.6%；預期未來一年財務狀況將惡化的比例，也由30.3%攀升至32.6%。受訪者對目前及未來取得信用的難易程度同樣更加悲觀。
勞動市場訊號則呈現分歧。受訪者認為自己未來一年失去工作的機率降至13.8%，創2月以來最低；主動離職機率連續第二個月上升至19.5%，高於過去12個月平均。這兩項變化主要由最高學歷為高中及家庭年收入低於10萬美元的族群推動。
不過，預期全美失業率未來一年上升的平均機率攀至44.4%，創2020年4月新冠疫情重創經濟以來最高，而且各年齡、教育及收入族群均轉趨悲觀。若意外失業，受訪者認為3個月內找到新工作的機率也降至45%。
物價方面，消費者對未來一年及5年的通膨預期分別維持在3.6%與3%；未來3年通膨預期則由3.3%小幅降至3.2%。不過，受訪者預期一年後汽油價格將進一步上漲。
這份調查出爐前，美國8月非農就業意外增加16.2萬人，超越市場所有預測，失業率則維持在4.1%，顯示即使面臨對伊戰爭與通膨持續偏高等不確定性，勞動市場仍具韌性。
聯準會(Fed)將於9月15日至16日召開決策會議，此前已連續5次按兵不動，目前政策利率維持在3.50%至3.75%。美國周四將公布8月生產者物價指數(PPI)，周五公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)則可能決定Fed本月是否升息。
Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)表示，若通膨繼續朝2%目標改善，他願意支持維持利率不變；但克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克(Beth Hammack)認為，物價壓力仍然沉重，現在已是採取行動壓低通膨的時候。
paras_en: The New York Fed released its August Consumer Expectations Survey on Tuesday (the 8th), showing that U.S. households are becoming increasingly pessimistic about their personal finances and the overall labor market. While inflation expectations remain roughly stable, a growing share of respondents say their own financial situation has deteriorated and they fear unemployment could rise over the next year.

The survey found that respondents who said their household finances were "much worse" or "somewhat worse" than a year ago rose to 38.6% from 37.6% in July, and the share expecting their financial situation to worsen over the next year climbed to 32.6% from 30.3%. Respondents also grew more pessimistic about the ease of obtaining credit now and in the future.

Labor‑market signals were mixed. The probability respondents assigned to losing their job in the next year fell to 13.8%, the lowest since February, while the chance of voluntarily quitting rose for the second month in a row to 19.5%, above the 12‑month average. These shifts were driven mainly by those whose highest education level is high school and whose household income is under $100,000.

Nevertheless, the average probability that the national unemployment rate will rise over the next year jumped to 44.4%, the highest since the pandemic‑hit April 2020, and pessimism spread across all age, education and income groups. If they were to lose their job unexpectedly, respondents said the chance of finding a new job within three months fell to 45%.

On prices, consumers kept their one‑year and five‑year inflation expectations at 3.6% and 3.0% respectively, while the three‑year outlook slipped slightly to 3.2% from 3.3%. However, respondents expect gasoline prices to rise further a year from now.

Before this survey was released, August non‑farm payrolls unexpectedly added 162,000 jobs, beating all market forecasts, while the unemployment rate held at 4.1%, indicating that despite uncertainties such as the war in Ukraine and persistently high inflation, the labor market remains resilient.

The Federal Reserve will hold its policy meeting on September 15‑16; it has paused for five consecutive meetings, leaving the target range for the policy rate at 3.50%‑3.75%. The U.S. will publish the August Producer Price Index on Thursday, and Friday’s Consumer Price Index release could determine whether the Fed raises rates this month.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller said that if inflation continues to move toward the 2% goal, he is willing to support keeping rates unchanged; but Boston Fed President Beth Hammack argued that price pressures remain heavy and it is time to act to bring inflation down.

items.title: 被質疑變相印鈔救債市！貝森特：擴大美債回購只是退燒、不是QE
items.title_en: Questioned as a Disguised Money‑Printing Bailout for the Bond Market! Bessent: Expanding Treasury Repurchases Is Just a Fever‑Reduction, Not QE
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周二(8日)表示，上月擴大回購舊債計畫，是為了替持續升溫的美國公債市場「退燒」，讓市場價格重新朝均衡狀態靠攏，而非試圖人為壓低殖利率。
貝森特在華盛頓出席Breitbart News活動時表示，他的職責是努力推動市場回歸均衡，雖然財政部無法改變均衡價格，但市場實際上從來不會完全處於均衡狀態。
這番談話發表之際，財政部預定周三進行擴大計畫後首場長天期舊債回購操作。此前，30年期美債殖利率一度升至2007年以來最高，引發市場對長債需求、財政赤字及政府舉債能力的疑慮。
曾任避險基金主管的貝森特表示，當時債市就像正在發燒，投機交易者往往會試圖加速市場走勢，因此財政部有必要介入，避免波動自我強化。財政部透過買回流動性較差的舊債，可望改善交易環境並緩解市場失序風險。
不過，貝森特否認近期美債價格下跌，是因投資人擔憂美國政府借款規模及信用狀況。他指出，如果市場真的質疑美國信用，投資人理應賣出美債、轉買德國公債，但實際走勢恰好相反，美債表現仍優於德債。
貝森特也反駁外界把擴大回購視為另一種量化寬鬆(QE)的說法。QE是聯準會(Fed)過去在危機期間透過大規模購債壓低利率、刺激經濟的政策工具，而財政部此次行動主要著眼於改善債市運作，並非放寬貨幣政策。
他將這項計畫形容為Fed過去「扭轉操作」(Operation Twist)的某種版本，透過調整不同期限債券的供需結構，緩解長天期市場壓力。貝森特強調，財政部只是為債市降溫及恢復秩序，並不是在推動QE。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Tuesday (the 8th) that the expansion of the old‑debt repurchase program last month was intended to “reduce the fever” in the overheating U.S. Treasury market, nudging prices back toward equilibrium rather than artificially suppressing yields.

Speaking at a Breitbart News event in Washington, Bessent said his job is to help steer the market back to balance; while the Treasury cannot set the equilibrium price, the market never truly sits at equilibrium in practice.

The remarks came as the Treasury prepared to conduct the first long‑term old‑debt repurchase under the expanded plan on Wednesday. Earlier, the 30‑year Treasury yield had spiked to its highest level since 2007, raising concerns about demand for long bonds, the fiscal deficit, and the government’s borrowing capacity.

Bessent, a former hedge‑fund manager, likened the bond market at the time to a feverish patient, noting that speculative traders tend to accelerate market moves, so Treasury intervention was needed to prevent self‑reinforcing volatility. By buying back less‑liquid older issues, the Treasury hopes to improve trading conditions and ease the risk of market disorder.

However, Bessent denied that the recent decline in Treasury prices was driven by investor worries about the size of U.S. borrowing or credit quality. He pointed out that if the market truly doubted U.S. credit, investors would sell Treasuries and shift to German bonds, yet the opposite occurred, with Treasuries outperforming German debt.

Bessent also rejected the view that the expanded repurchase program amounts to another round of quantitative easing (QE). QE was a tool the Federal Reserve used during crises to buy large amounts of bonds, lower rates and spur growth, whereas this Treasury action is aimed at improving market functioning, not loosening monetary policy.

He described the plan as a variant of the Fed’s past “Operation Twist,” adjusting the supply‑demand balance across different maturities to relieve pressure in the long‑term market. Bessent stressed that the Treasury is simply cooling the bond market and restoring order, not launching QE.

items.title: 格芯獲美商務部3.75億美元研發補助 携手Rigetti、Quantinuum打造美國量子晶片製造樞紐
items.title_en: GlobalFoundries Receives $375 Million U.S. Department of Commerce R&D Grant, Partners with Rigetti and Quantinuum to Build a U.S. Quantum Chip Manufacturing Hub
paras: 美國晶片製造商格芯週二(8日)宣布，已與美國商務部《晶片法案》研發辦公室敲定最終協議，獲得3.75億美元研發資助，以加快其量子技術解決方案(QTS)業務的發展軌跡。該業務旨在擴大美國本土基於量子計算的半導體製造規模，並鞏固美國在全球「下一代計算革命」，也就是量子運算領域的領先地位。
根據補貼協議，格芯有資格在五年內獲得最高3.75億美元資金，具體撥付與指定里程碑的達成情況掛鉤。
幾乎同一時間，美國本土三大量子運算新勢力同傳捷報：Rigetti Computing與D-Wave Quantum週二股價開盤大漲近10%，Quantinuum漲逾5%。三者週二也跟美國商務部簽署最終協議，獲得1億美元資金，用於加速研發項目，應對超導量子計算機大規模擴展過程中的關鍵技術挑戰。
美方此輪補助金分配，凸顯其對掌握量子運算核心製造基礎的重視。IBM與格芯兩筆補助合計13.75億美元，占總額約68.3%。IBM打算配套投入10億美元現金，使其Anderon項目初始現金投入達20億美元，並建設服務IBM及外部客戶的300毫米量子晶圓代工平台。
由此可見，美國希望同時占據量子晶片工藝、製造產能、供應鏈與商業生態的關鍵位置，而非僅押注單一量子公司的突破。川普政府6月公布的量子行政行動，則進一步強調國家戰略、可信供應鏈及產業化。
paras_en: GlobalFoundries, the U.S. chipmaker, announced on Tuesday (the 8th) that it has reached a final agreement with the U.S. Department of Commerce’s CHIPS Act R&D office, securing a $375 million research and development grant to accelerate the trajectory of its Quantum Technology Solutions (QTS) business. The initiative aims to expand domestic semiconductor manufacturing based on quantum computing and to cement the United States’ leading position in the global “next‑generation computing revolution,” i.e., the quantum computing arena.
Under the subsidy agreement, GlobalFoundries is eligible to receive up to $375 million over five years, with disbursements tied to the achievement of specified milestones.

Almost simultaneously, three major U.S. quantum‑computing newcomers reported good news: Rigetti Computing and D‑Wave Quantum saw their stock prices jump nearly 10% at market open on Tuesday, while Quantinuum rose more than 5%. The three also signed final agreements with the U.S. Department of Commerce, receiving a combined $100 million to speed up R&D projects and address key technical challenges in scaling superconducting quantum computers.

The U.S. grant allocation underscores the emphasis on mastering the core manufacturing foundations of quantum computing. Grants to IBM and GlobalFoundries together total $1.375 billion, about 68.3% of the overall pot. IBM plans to match with $1 billion in cash, bringing its Anderson project’s initial cash investment to $2 billion and building a 300‑mm quantum wafer foundry platform serving IBM and external customers.

This shows that the United States seeks to occupy the critical positions of quantum‑chip process technology, manufacturing capacity, supply chain, and commercial ecosystem, rather than betting on a single quantum firm’s breakthrough. The quantum executive action announced by the Trump administration in June further emphasizes national strategy, a trusted supply chain, and industrialization.

items.title_en: Philip Morris Highlights Strong Taiwan Market Performance, Smokeless Products as Global Growth Driver
paras: 2026年09月09日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Philip Morris International(PM-US)持續加快從傳統紙菸轉向無煙產品，執行長Jacek Olczak表示，美國ZYN尼古丁袋與IQOS加熱菸仍是主要成長動能，並特別點名台灣市場，表示公司對目前在台灣的表現相當滿意。
但主要原因是Philip Morris過去在台灣傳統紙菸市場的布局較小，因此發展無煙產品時，較不需要面對既有紙菸業務遭到侵蝕的問題，有利公司積極拓展新產品。
Philip Morris同步上調2026年獲利財測，主要受惠匯率環境改善。公司預估全年每股盈餘由原先7.19至7.34美元提高至7.28至7.43美元；調整後每股盈餘則由8.26至8.41美元上修至8.35至8.50美元，相較市場預估8.37美元，新財測區間中高端已高於市場預期。
公司此前與高特力集團Altria(MO-US)旗下Philip Morris USA簽署委託製造協議，由Philip Morris USA為Philip Morris International的非美國關係企業提供生產服務，首批出貨預計於2027年初開始，雙方希望藉此提高營運效率與製造能力。
這項安排並不代表Philip Morris準備重返美國傳統紙菸市場。Philip Morris USA仍屬於Altria旗下菸草事業，雙方維持獨立營運；Philip Morris International也表示，目前仍沒有在美國銷售傳統紙菸的計畫。這項製造合作預期不會對雙方2026年財務表現造成重大影響。
從全球市場來看，日本已成為加熱菸成熟度的重要指標，加熱菸占當地整體尼古丁市場銷量比重已超過50%。儘管2026年至2027年日本接連面臨菸稅與價格調整，Philip Morris表示，加熱菸市場在短期波動後已逐步恢復成長，IQOS仍維持很高的市場地位。
美國則是下一階段最重要的成長市場。Philip Morris認為，美國尼古丁袋市場中長期仍具有20%以上成長潛力，公司近期推出ZYN Ultra並大幅擴充產品組合，過去2個月新增超過20個SKU，同時增加品牌與通路投資，持續擴大ZYN滲透率。
IQOS也可能成為Philip Morris在美國的另一項成長動能。目前公司仍等待美國食品藥物管理局(FDA)對IQOS ILUMA的相關授權，並表示取得許可後已準備好推向市場。Olczak認為，參考其他國家的發展經驗，加熱菸長期有機會占美國紙菸與加熱菸合計市場約10%。

paras_en: September 9, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Philip Morris International (PM-US) continues to accelerate its shift from traditional cigarettes to smokeless products. CEO Jacek Olczak said that the US ZYN nicotine pouches and IQOS heated tobacco remain the main growth engines, and he singled out the Taiwan market, stating that the company is very satisfied with its performance there.

The main reason is that Philip Morris had a relatively small footprint in Taiwan’s traditional cigarette market, so when developing smokeless products it faced less cannibalisation of existing cigarette business, facilitating aggressive expansion of new products.

Philip Morris also raised its 2026 earnings outlook, mainly benefiting from an improved currency environment. The company now expects full‑year earnings per share of $7.28‑$7.43, up from the prior $7.19‑$7.34 range; adjusted EPS is revised to $8.35‑$8.50 from $8.26‑$8.41, which is above the market consensus of $8.37, placing the higher end of the new range above expectations.

The company previously signed a contract manufacturing agreement with Altria’s Philip Morris USA, a subsidiary of the Altria Group (MO‑US). Under the deal, Philip Morris USA will provide production services for Philip Morris International’s non‑US affiliates, with the first shipments slated for early 2027. Both parties hope the arrangement will boost operational efficiency and manufacturing capacity.

The arrangement does not indicate that Philip Morris is preparing to re‑enter the US traditional cigarette market. Philip Morris USA remains part of Altria’s tobacco business and the two entities will continue to operate independently; Philip Morris International also says it has no plans to sell traditional cigarettes in the United States. The manufacturing collaboration is not expected to have a material impact on either side’s 2026 financial results.

Globally, Japan has become a key benchmark for heated‑tobacco maturity, with heated products now accounting for more than 50% of the country’s total nicotine market sales. Despite facing tobacco tax and price adjustments in 2026‑2027, Philip Morris said the heated‑tobacco market has been gradually recovering after short‑term volatility, and IQOS continues to hold a strong market position.

The United States is the next most important growth market. Philip Morris believes the US nicotine‑pouch market still has more than 20% long‑term growth potential. The company recently launched ZYN Ultra and significantly expanded its product portfolio, adding over 20 new SKUs in the past two months, while increasing brand and channel investments to further boost ZYN penetration.

IQOS could also become another growth driver for Philip Morris in the US. The company is awaiting FDA authorization for IQOS ILUMA and says it is ready to launch the product once approval is obtained. Olczak noted that, based on experiences in other countries, heated tobacco could eventually capture about 10% of the combined US cigarette and heated‑tobacco market.
