items.title: 阿斯特捷利康COPD新藥告捷！年銷售高峰估逾50億美元
items.title_en: AstraZeneca's COPD New Drug Triumphs, Forecasts Over $5 Billion Annual Sales
paras: 英國製藥大廠阿斯特捷利康(AZN-US)周二(8日)公布兩項慢性阻塞性肺病(COPD)後期臨床試驗完整結果，實驗性生物製劑tozorakimab可使廣泛患者族群的中度及重度急性惡化減少約30%，不僅達到或超越分析師預期，也提高這款藥物成為年銷售額逾50億美元重磅產品的希望。
Tozorakimab目前正接受美國食品藥物管理局(FDA)優先審查，預計最快2027年第一季取得美國批准，歐盟與中國等主要市場也在審查中。這款藥物每4周注射一次，在兩項試驗的主要前吸菸者族群中，分別使中度及重度急性惡化減少29%與34%；涵蓋目前及過去吸菸者的整體族群中，降幅則分別達30%與29%。
試驗結果已刊登於《新英格蘭醫學期刊》(New England Journal of Medicine)，並在歐洲呼吸學會年會發表。阿斯特捷利康表示，患者整體耐受性良好，主要不良反應為注射部位反應。

突破現有療法限制 低嗜酸性球患者也受益

COPD是一種會阻塞氣流、造成呼吸困難的漸進性肺部疾病，症狀包括咳嗽、反覆胸腔感染及呼吸急促，目前無法治癒，但治療可延緩惡化。阿斯特捷利康估計，美國確診及未確診患者合計約1,600萬至2,600萬人，COPD也是美國第五大死因。
目前已獲准治療COPD的生物製劑，包括再生元製藥(REGN-US)與賽諾菲(SNY-US)共同開發的Dupixent，以及葛蘭素史克(GSK-US)的Nucala，但主要適用於嗜酸性球數值偏高的患者。嗜酸性球是一種與發炎反應有關的白血球，現有療法僅能涵蓋約30%的COPD患者，其餘約70%患者獲益有限或完全無效。
Tozorakimab試驗則納入現有及過去吸菸者、不同肺功能嚴重程度，以及各種嗜酸性球數值的患者。分析顯示，在嗜酸性球數值低於150的族群中，急性惡化減少23%；數值達150以上者減少34%，300以上者降幅更達43%。
阿斯特捷利康生物製藥事業部總裁Ruud Dobber表示，目前沒有生物製劑可供嗜酸性球數值低於150的COPD患者使用，tozorakimab憑藉廣泛適用性，有機會真正改變治療模式。

阻斷兩條IL-33路徑 年銷售額上看50億美元

Tozorakimab藉由阻斷會引發發炎與黏液生成的免疫蛋白IL-33發揮作用。其他藥廠過去開發抗IL-33療法的成果有限，包括賽諾菲與羅氏(RHHBY-US)旗下藥物均未展現同等成效，導致投資人一度質疑這類療法的潛力。
阿斯特捷利康認為，tozorakimab成功之處在於可同時抑制兩條不同的IL-33路徑，不只能控制發炎，也可能減少黏液生成與呼吸道損傷。執行長蘇博科(Pascal Soriot)坦言，公司原先也認為成功機率不高，市場預測幾乎未替這款藥物計入任何價值，最終結果卻證明藥物有效。
阿斯特捷利康近期將tozorakimab的年銷售高峰預測提高至逾50億美元，可望協助公司實現2030年營收800億美元的目標。該藥目前也正進行重度氣喘第二期試驗及重度病毒性下呼吸道疾病第三期試驗，未來還可能擴及支氣管擴張症等由IL-33驅動的疾病。
不過，密西根大學醫療體系肺部與重症照護部門主管Meilan Han指出，由於尚無試驗直接比較tozorakimab與Dupixent及Nucala，醫師仍須判斷對嗜酸性球偏高患者應優先採用哪種療法，未來需要更多子群分析才能確立其治療定位。
paras_en: AstraZeneca (AZN-US) announced on Tuesday the complete results of two late‑stage clinical trials for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). The experimental biologic tozorakimab reduced moderate and severe acute exacerbations by about 30% across a broad patient population, meeting or exceeding analyst expectations and raising hopes that the drug could become a product generating more than $5 billion in annual sales.

Tozorakimab is currently under priority review by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and could receive U.S. approval as early as the first quarter of 2027, with the European Union, China and other major markets also reviewing it. The drug is administered by injection every four weeks and, in the two trials’ primary former‑smoker cohorts, cut moderate and severe acute exacerbations by 29% and 34% respectively; in the overall population that includes current and former smokers, the reductions were 30% and 29%.

The trial results were published in the New England Journal of Medicine and presented at the European Respiratory Society annual meeting. AstraZeneca said overall tolerability was good, with the main adverse event being injection‑site reactions.

Breaking the limits of existing therapies, even patients with low eosinophil counts benefit. COPD is a progressive lung disease that blocks airflow and causes breathing difficulty, with symptoms such as cough, recurrent chest infections and shortness of breath. It is incurable, but treatment can slow progression. AstraZeneca estimates that 16‑26 million people in the United States have diagnosed or undiagnosed COPD, which is the fifth leading cause of death in the country.

Biologics already approved for COPD include Dupixent, co‑developed by Regeneron (REGN-US) and Sanofi (SNY-US), and Nucala from GlaxoSmithKline (GSK-US), but they are mainly indicated for patients with elevated eosinophil counts. Eosinophils are a type of white blood cell linked to inflammation; current therapies cover only about 30% of COPD patients, leaving roughly 70% with limited or no benefit.

The tozorakimab trials enrolled current and former smokers, patients with varying degrees of lung function impairment, and a range of eosinophil levels. Analyses showed that in patients with eosinophil counts below 150, acute exacerbations fell by 23%; those with counts of 150 or higher saw a 34% reduction, and patients with counts above 300 experienced a 43% drop.

Ruud Dobber, president of AstraZeneca’s biopharma division, said there is currently no biologic available for COPD patients with eosinophil counts below 150, and that tozorakimab’s broad applicability could truly change the treatment paradigm.

Blocking two IL‑33 pathways could drive $5 billion in annual sales. Tozorakimab works by blocking the immune protein IL‑33, which triggers inflammation and mucus production. Other companies’ attempts at anti‑IL‑33 therapies have yielded limited results, including drugs from Sanofi and Roche (RHHBY-US), leading investors to question the potential of this approach.

AstraZeneca believes tozorakimab’s success lies in its ability to inhibit two distinct IL‑33 pathways simultaneously, not only controlling inflammation but also potentially reducing mucus production and airway damage. CEO Pascal Soriot admitted the company originally thought the odds of success were low and that market forecasts had assigned virtually no value to the drug, yet the outcome proved the drug’s efficacy.

AstraZeneca has recently raised its peak‑year sales forecast for tozorakimab to over $5 billion, which could help the company reach its goal of $80 billion in revenue by 2030. The drug is also in phase‑2 trials for severe asthma and phase‑3 trials for severe viral lower‑respiratory‑tract disease, and may later be tested in other IL‑33‑driven conditions such as bronchiectasis.

However, Meilan Han, head of pulmonary and critical care at the University of Michigan Health System, cautioned that because no head‑to‑head trials have compared tozorakimab with Dupixent or Nucala, physicians must still decide which therapy to prioritize for patients with high eosinophil counts. More subgroup analyses will be needed in the future to define its therapeutic positioning.

items.title: 羅賓漢又押中熱門商機！入股Crypto.com搶攻預測市場
items.title_en: Robinhood Strikes Another Hot Deal! Investing in Crypto.com to Attack the Prediction Market
paras: 根據《華爾街日報》周二(8日)報導，羅賓漢(Robinhood Markets)(HOOD-US)宣布與加密貨幣交易所Crypto.com達成多年期合作，將在旗下交易平台引進由Crypto.com預測市場業務OG.com支援的「是或否」事件合約，並取得Crypto.com及OG少數股權，進一步擴大預測市場布局。
雙方未公布協議金額及羅賓漢的投資規模。Crypto.com同時宣布，已將OG分拆為獨立公司。今年7月，城堡證券(Citadel Securities)分別入股Crypto.com與OG後，兩家公司估值各達150億美元及50億美元。
預測市場允許交易者針對選舉、體育賽事或其他事件結果買賣合約，近年迅速受到散戶歡迎，但監管前景仍充滿不確定性。羅賓漢去年已與美國最大預測市場平台Kalshi合作，提供更多種類的事件合約，之後又陸續透過其他合作夥伴擴大業務。
羅賓漢與Susquehanna International Group共同成立的衍生品交易所Rothera，也將事件合約列為業務重點。此次與Crypto.com合作後，羅賓漢表示，可為客戶提供更優惠的價格及更多元的合約選擇。
Crypto.com執行長Kris Marszalek表示，預測市場事件合約只是雙方推出的第一項產品，這段合作關係才剛開始。雙方也曾討論推出與股票連動的永續期貨，但仍須等待監管機關批准。
Crypto.com自2024年底起便透過旗下衍生品部門提供預測市場合約，並於今年2月推出獨立平台OG。Marszalek表示，OG今年業務規模已成長約20倍，與羅賓漢合作可望吸引更多散戶及機構投資人進場，讓機構與散戶交易流量相互匹配。
Crypto.com在2025年底曾與川普媒體科技集團(DJT-US)合作，計畫將預測市場直接整合至Truth Social，但雙方上月以市場環境及商業優先順序改變為由終止合作。
Marszalek透露，Crypto.com接下來將尋求透過併購擴大成長，並正為首次公開募股(IPO)做準備，但尚未決定上市時間。
羅賓漢期貨與預測市場副總裁兼總經理JB Mackenzie表示，美式足球賽季開始，加上秋季期中選舉即將登場，事件合約業務正進入關鍵旺季。此次合作除可滿足客戶需求，也讓羅賓漢在預測市場擁有更直接的利益。
paras_en: According to a Wall Street Journal report on Tuesday the 8th, Robinhood Markets (HOOD-US) announced a multi‑year partnership with cryptocurrency exchange Crypto.com, bringing “yes‑or‑no” event contracts powered by Crypto.com’s prediction‑market business OG.com onto its platform and acquiring minority stakes in Crypto.com and OG to further expand its footprint in the prediction‑market space.

The parties did not disclose the agreement’s monetary value or the size of Robinhood’s investment. Crypto.com also announced that it has spun OG out as an independent company. In July this year, Citadel Securities took stakes in both Crypto.com and OG, valuing the two firms at $15 billion and $5 billion respectively.

Prediction markets let traders buy and sell contracts on the outcomes of elections, sports events or other occurrences. They have surged in popularity with retail investors in recent years, though regulatory outlooks remain uncertain. Robinhood partnered last year with Kalshi, the largest U.S. prediction‑market platform, to offer a broader range of event contracts and has since expanded its offerings through additional partners.

Robinhood’s derivatives exchange Rothera, which it co‑founded with Susquehanna International Group, also lists event contracts as a core product. Following the Crypto.com deal, Robinhood said it can offer customers better pricing and a more diverse selection of contracts.

Crypto.com CEO Kris Marszalek said the event‑contract prediction market is only the first product the two firms will launch together and that the partnership is just getting started. They have also discussed rolling out stock‑linked perpetual futures, pending regulatory approval.

Crypto.com began offering prediction‑market contracts through its derivatives unit at the end of 2024 and launched the standalone OG platform in February this year. Marszalek said OG’s business has grown roughly twenty‑fold in 2023, and the collaboration with Robinhood is expected to draw more retail and institutional investors, matching institutional and retail trading flow.

At the end of 2025 Crypto.com partnered with Trump Media & Technology Group (DJT-US) to integrate prediction markets directly into Truth Social, but the two parties terminated the effort last month citing changes in market conditions and commercial priorities.
Marszalek disclosed that Crypto.com will seek growth through acquisitions and is preparing for an initial public offering, though a listing date has not yet been set.

JB Mackenzie, Robinhood’s vice‑president and general manager of futures and prediction markets, said the start of the NFL season and the upcoming midterm elections signal a peak season for event‑contract business. The partnership not only meets client demand but also gives Robinhood a more direct stake in the prediction‑market ecosystem.

items.title_en: Verizon Splurges Billions! Corning Becomes AI Fiber Optic Big Winner as Stock Soars Over 8% Intraday
paras: 康寧(GLW-US)周二(8日)盤中飆逾8%，此前電信巨擘威瑞森(VZ-US)宣布與康寧簽署一項價值數十億美元的長期供應協議，將採購超過8,000萬英里高容量光纖，用於擴大全美寬頻網路及建設新一代人工智慧(AI)基礎設施。
截稿前，康寧(GLW-US)盤中股價上漲8.11%，每股暫報166.81美元。
這項協議將持續至2032年。威瑞森表示，康寧提供的光纖除可擴大消費者取得寬頻服務的範圍，也將支援生成式AI的運算需求。公司計畫把地區寬頻、行動通訊與長距離AI基礎設施整合至單一高容量網路，建立能同時服務家庭、企業及AI超大規模雲端業者的融合架構。
威瑞森執行長Kyle Malady表示，取得如此龐大的光纖供應量，將使公司以前所未有的規模建設未來網路。這套統一架構可把行動通訊及寬頻整合成無縫服務，同時打造AI業者所需的高容量、低延遲骨幹網路。
威瑞森股價盤中小跌0.12%，每股暫報50.08美元，其他光通訊類股則走高。Ciena(CIEN-US)漲逾6%%、Coherent(COHR-US)與Lumentum(LITE-US)漲近11%。
隨AI資料中心快速擴張，光纖與光通訊設備日益成為AI投資熱潮的重要環節。康寧近月接連取得科技及電信業者的大型合約，也進一步凸顯其在AI基礎設施供應鏈中的關鍵地位。
康寧今年6月才與亞馬遜(AMZN-US)簽署價值數十億美元的資料中心光纖生產協議。輝達(NVDA-US)5月也宣布向康寧投資最高32億美元，協助其擴充德州與北卡羅來納州的光通訊製造產能；今年1月，康寧另取得Meta Platforms(META-US)價值60億美元的資料中心纜線、光纖及連接解決方案訂單。
康寧7月底公布的第二季獲利優於市場預期，但財測表現令人失望。執行長Wendell Weeks當時表示，公司正邁入成長加速的新階段。此次威瑞森簽下超過8,000萬英里光纖大單，可望進一步強化康寧的營收成長動能。
paras_en: Corning (GLW-US) surged more than 8% during Tuesday’s (the 8th) trading session after telecom giant Verizon (VZ-US) announced it had signed a multi‑billion‑dollar long‑term supply agreement with Corning to purchase over 80 million miles of high‑capacity fiber for expanding its nationwide broadband network and building next‑generation artificial‑intelligence (AI) infrastructure.
By the time of press, Corning’s (GLW-US) intraday price was up 8.11%, briefly reporting $166.81 per share.

The agreement runs through 2032. Verizon said the fiber supplied by Corning will not only broaden consumer access to broadband services but also support the compute demands of generative AI. The company plans to integrate regional broadband, mobile communications and long‑haul AI infrastructure into a single high‑capacity network, creating a converged architecture that can simultaneously serve homes, enterprises and ultra‑large‑scale AI cloud providers.

Verizon CEO Kyle Malady said that securing such a massive fiber supply will enable the company to build the future network at an unprecedented scale. The unified architecture can merge mobile and broadband into a seamless service while delivering the high‑capacity, low‑latency backbone that AI providers require.

Verizon’s stock slipped 0.12% intraday, briefly at $50.08 per share, while other optical‑communications stocks rose. Ciena (CIEN-US) jumped more than 6%, and Coherent (COHR-US) and Lumentum (LITE-US) each climbed close to 11%.

With AI data centers expanding rapidly, fiber and optical‑communication equipment are becoming a key component of the AI investment boom. Corning’s recent string of large contracts with technology and telecom firms further underscores its pivotal role in the AI infrastructure supply chain.

Corning only in June signed a multi‑billion‑dollar data‑center fiber production agreement with Amazon (AMZN-US). In May, Nvidia (NVDA-US) announced an investment of up to $3.2 billion in Corning to help expand its optical‑communication manufacturing capacity in Texas and North Carolina; and in January the company secured a $6 billion order from Meta Platforms (META-US) for data‑center cables, fiber and connectivity solutions.

Corning reported second‑quarter earnings at the end of July that beat market expectations, though its outlook disappointed analysts. CEO Wendell Weeks said the company was entering a new phase of accelerated growth. The massive Verizon order for more than 80 million miles of fiber is expected to further strengthen Corning’s revenue‑growth momentum.

items.title: 非農強勁也無感！美國家庭財務惡化、失業率預期創逾6年新高
items.title_en: Strong Nonfarm Payrolls Still Unfelt: US Household Finances Worsen, Unemployment Rate Outlook Hits Over Six-Year High
paras: 紐約聯準銀行周二(8日)公布的8月消費者預期調查顯示，美國家庭對個人財務及整體就業市場的看法轉趨悲觀。儘管通膨預期大致穩定，愈來愈多受訪者認為自身財務狀況已經惡化，並擔心未來一年失業率上升。
調查顯示，認為家庭財務狀況較一年前「差很多」或「差一些」的受訪者占比，從7月的37.6%升至38.6%；預期未來一年財務狀況將惡化的比例，也由30.3%攀升至32.6%。受訪者對目前及未來取得信用的難易程度同樣更加悲觀。
勞動市場訊號則呈現分歧。受訪者認為自己未來一年失去工作的機率降至13.8%，創2月以來最低；主動離職機率連續第二個月上升至19.5%，高於過去12個月平均。這兩項變化主要由最高學歷為高中及家庭年收入低於10萬美元的族群推動。
不過，預期全美失業率未來一年上升的平均機率攀至44.4%，創2020年4月新冠疫情重創經濟以來最高，而且各年齡、教育及收入族群均轉趨悲觀。若意外失業，受訪者認為3個月內找到新工作的機率也降至45%。
物價方面，消費者對未來一年及5年的通膨預期分別維持在3.6%與3%；未來3年通膨預期則由3.3%小幅降至3.2%。不過，受訪者預期一年後汽油價格將進一步上漲。
這份調查出爐前，美國8月非農就業意外增加16.2萬人，超越市場所有預測，失業率則維持在4.1%，顯示即使面臨對伊戰爭與通膨持續偏高等不確定性，勞動市場仍具韌性。
聯準會(Fed)將於9月15日至16日召開決策會議，此前已連續5次按兵不動，目前政策利率維持在3.50%至3.75%。美國周四將公布8月生產者物價指數(PPI)，周五公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)則可能決定Fed本月是否升息。
Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)表示，若通膨繼續朝2%目標改善，他願意支持維持利率不變；但克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克(Beth Hammack)認為，物價壓力仍然沉重，現在已是採取行動壓低通膨的時候。
paras_en: The New York Fed released its August Consumer Expectations Survey on Tuesday (the 8th), showing that U.S. households are becoming increasingly pessimistic about their personal finances and the overall labor market. While inflation expectations remain roughly stable, a growing share of respondents say their own financial situation has deteriorated and they fear unemployment could rise over the next year.

The survey found that respondents who said their household finances were "much worse" or "somewhat worse" than a year ago rose to 38.6% from 37.6% in July, and the share expecting their financial situation to worsen over the next year climbed to 32.6% from 30.3%. Respondents also grew more pessimistic about the ease of obtaining credit now and in the future.

Labor‑market signals were mixed. The probability respondents assigned to losing their job in the next year fell to 13.8%, the lowest since February, while the chance of voluntarily quitting rose for the second month in a row to 19.5%, above the 12‑month average. These shifts were driven mainly by those whose highest education level is high school and whose household income is under $100,000.

Nevertheless, the average probability that the national unemployment rate will rise over the next year jumped to 44.4%, the highest since the pandemic‑hit April 2020, and pessimism spread across all age, education and income groups. If they were to lose their job unexpectedly, respondents said the chance of finding a new job within three months fell to 45%.

On prices, consumers kept their one‑year and five‑year inflation expectations at 3.6% and 3.0% respectively, while the three‑year outlook slipped slightly to 3.2% from 3.3%. However, respondents expect gasoline prices to rise further a year from now.

Before this survey was released, August non‑farm payrolls unexpectedly added 162,000 jobs, beating all market forecasts, while the unemployment rate held at 4.1%, indicating that despite uncertainties such as the war in Ukraine and persistently high inflation, the labor market remains resilient.

The Federal Reserve will hold its policy meeting on September 15‑16; it has paused for five consecutive meetings, leaving the target range for the policy rate at 3.50%‑3.75%. The U.S. will publish the August Producer Price Index on Thursday, and Friday’s Consumer Price Index release could determine whether the Fed raises rates this month.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller said that if inflation continues to move toward the 2% goal, he is willing to support keeping rates unchanged; but Boston Fed President Beth Hammack argued that price pressures remain heavy and it is time to act to bring inflation down.

items.title: 被質疑變相印鈔救債市！貝森特：擴大美債回購只是退燒、不是QE
items.title_en: Questioned as a Disguised Money‑Printing Bailout for the Bond Market! Bessent: Expanding Treasury Repurchases Is Just a Fever‑Reduction, Not QE
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周二(8日)表示，上月擴大回購舊債計畫，是為了替持續升溫的美國公債市場「退燒」，讓市場價格重新朝均衡狀態靠攏，而非試圖人為壓低殖利率。
貝森特在華盛頓出席Breitbart News活動時表示，他的職責是努力推動市場回歸均衡，雖然財政部無法改變均衡價格，但市場實際上從來不會完全處於均衡狀態。
這番談話發表之際，財政部預定周三進行擴大計畫後首場長天期舊債回購操作。此前，30年期美債殖利率一度升至2007年以來最高，引發市場對長債需求、財政赤字及政府舉債能力的疑慮。
曾任避險基金主管的貝森特表示，當時債市就像正在發燒，投機交易者往往會試圖加速市場走勢，因此財政部有必要介入，避免波動自我強化。財政部透過買回流動性較差的舊債，可望改善交易環境並緩解市場失序風險。
不過，貝森特否認近期美債價格下跌，是因投資人擔憂美國政府借款規模及信用狀況。他指出，如果市場真的質疑美國信用，投資人理應賣出美債、轉買德國公債，但實際走勢恰好相反，美債表現仍優於德債。
貝森特也反駁外界把擴大回購視為另一種量化寬鬆(QE)的說法。QE是聯準會(Fed)過去在危機期間透過大規模購債壓低利率、刺激經濟的政策工具，而財政部此次行動主要著眼於改善債市運作，並非放寬貨幣政策。
他將這項計畫形容為Fed過去「扭轉操作」(Operation Twist)的某種版本，透過調整不同期限債券的供需結構，緩解長天期市場壓力。貝森特強調，財政部只是為債市降溫及恢復秩序，並不是在推動QE。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Tuesday (the 8th) that the expansion of the old‑debt repurchase program last month was intended to “reduce the fever” in the overheating U.S. Treasury market, nudging prices back toward equilibrium rather than artificially suppressing yields.

Speaking at a Breitbart News event in Washington, Bessent said his job is to help steer the market back to balance; while the Treasury cannot set the equilibrium price, the market never truly sits at equilibrium in practice.

The remarks came as the Treasury prepared to conduct the first long‑term old‑debt repurchase under the expanded plan on Wednesday. Earlier, the 30‑year Treasury yield had spiked to its highest level since 2007, raising concerns about demand for long bonds, the fiscal deficit, and the government’s borrowing capacity.

Bessent, a former hedge‑fund manager, likened the bond market at the time to a feverish patient, noting that speculative traders tend to accelerate market moves, so Treasury intervention was needed to prevent self‑reinforcing volatility. By buying back less‑liquid older issues, the Treasury hopes to improve trading conditions and ease the risk of market disorder.

However, Bessent denied that the recent decline in Treasury prices was driven by investor worries about the size of U.S. borrowing or credit quality. He pointed out that if the market truly doubted U.S. credit, investors would sell Treasuries and shift to German bonds, yet the opposite occurred, with Treasuries outperforming German debt.

Bessent also rejected the view that the expanded repurchase program amounts to another round of quantitative easing (QE). QE was a tool the Federal Reserve used during crises to buy large amounts of bonds, lower rates and spur growth, whereas this Treasury action is aimed at improving market functioning, not loosening monetary policy.

He described the plan as a variant of the Fed’s past “Operation Twist,” adjusting the supply‑demand balance across different maturities to relieve pressure in the long‑term market. Bessent stressed that the Treasury is simply cooling the bond market and restoring order, not launching QE.

items.title: 格芯獲美商務部3.75億美元研發補助 携手Rigetti、Quantinuum打造美國量子晶片製造樞紐
items.title_en: GlobalFoundries Receives $375 Million U.S. Department of Commerce R&D Grant, Partners with Rigetti and Quantinuum to Build a U.S. Quantum Chip Manufacturing Hub
paras: 美國晶片製造商格芯週二(8日)宣布，已與美國商務部《晶片法案》研發辦公室敲定最終協議，獲得3.75億美元研發資助，以加快其量子技術解決方案(QTS)業務的發展軌跡。該業務旨在擴大美國本土基於量子計算的半導體製造規模，並鞏固美國在全球「下一代計算革命」，也就是量子運算領域的領先地位。
根據補貼協議，格芯有資格在五年內獲得最高3.75億美元資金，具體撥付與指定里程碑的達成情況掛鉤。
幾乎同一時間，美國本土三大量子運算新勢力同傳捷報：Rigetti Computing與D-Wave Quantum週二股價開盤大漲近10%，Quantinuum漲逾5%。三者週二也跟美國商務部簽署最終協議，獲得1億美元資金，用於加速研發項目，應對超導量子計算機大規模擴展過程中的關鍵技術挑戰。
美方此輪補助金分配，凸顯其對掌握量子運算核心製造基礎的重視。IBM與格芯兩筆補助合計13.75億美元，占總額約68.3%。IBM打算配套投入10億美元現金，使其Anderon項目初始現金投入達20億美元，並建設服務IBM及外部客戶的300毫米量子晶圓代工平台。
由此可見，美國希望同時占據量子晶片工藝、製造產能、供應鏈與商業生態的關鍵位置，而非僅押注單一量子公司的突破。川普政府6月公布的量子行政行動，則進一步強調國家戰略、可信供應鏈及產業化。
paras_en: GlobalFoundries, the U.S. chipmaker, announced on Tuesday (the 8th) that it has reached a final agreement with the U.S. Department of Commerce’s CHIPS Act R&D office, securing a $375 million research and development grant to accelerate the trajectory of its Quantum Technology Solutions (QTS) business. The initiative aims to expand domestic semiconductor manufacturing based on quantum computing and to cement the United States’ leading position in the global “next‑generation computing revolution,” i.e., the quantum computing arena.
Under the subsidy agreement, GlobalFoundries is eligible to receive up to $375 million over five years, with disbursements tied to the achievement of specified milestones.

Almost simultaneously, three major U.S. quantum‑computing newcomers reported good news: Rigetti Computing and D‑Wave Quantum saw their stock prices jump nearly 10% at market open on Tuesday, while Quantinuum rose more than 5%. The three also signed final agreements with the U.S. Department of Commerce, receiving a combined $100 million to speed up R&D projects and address key technical challenges in scaling superconducting quantum computers.

The U.S. grant allocation underscores the emphasis on mastering the core manufacturing foundations of quantum computing. Grants to IBM and GlobalFoundries together total $1.375 billion, about 68.3% of the overall pot. IBM plans to match with $1 billion in cash, bringing its Anderson project’s initial cash investment to $2 billion and building a 300‑mm quantum wafer foundry platform serving IBM and external customers.

This shows that the United States seeks to occupy the critical positions of quantum‑chip process technology, manufacturing capacity, supply chain, and commercial ecosystem, rather than betting on a single quantum firm’s breakthrough. The quantum executive action announced by the Trump administration in June further emphasizes national strategy, a trusted supply chain, and industrialization.

items.title: 【美股焦點】Bloom Energy納入標普500成分股、Nike遭剔除標普100，諾華新藥試驗失利拖累Amgen與禮來
items.title_en: US Stock Focus: Bloom Energy Added to S&P 500, Nike Removed from S&P 100, Novartis Trial Failure Drags Down Amgen and Eli Lilly
paras: 2026年09月09日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股週二焦點集中在生技、指數成分股調整與加密貨幣概念股，其中Amgen(AMGN-US)受到競爭藥物臨床試驗消息影響，盤前重挫超過5%；Bloom Energy(BE-US)則受惠即將納入標普500指數，盤前上漲4%。
生技股方面，瑞士製藥商諾華Novartis(NOVN-CH)表示，一款實驗性藥物在後期臨床試驗中未能降低心血管風險。由於Amgen與禮來Eli Lilly(LLY-US)正在開發競爭性療法，市場重新評估相關藥物的研發前景，Amgen盤前下跌超過5%，禮來股價也小幅走低；諾華在歐洲市場則重挫10%。
指數成分股調整方面，標普道瓊指數公司日前宣布，燃料電池業者Bloom Energy將於本月稍晚納入標普500指數，消息帶動Bloom Energy週二上漲逾10%。
相較之下，Nike(NKE-US)將被剔除標普100指數，股價小幅走低。
加密貨幣相關股票同步承壓。隨著比特幣價格下跌超過1%、跌破78,500美元，Coinbase Global(COIN-US)、Robinhood Markets(HOOD-US)與Strategy(MSTR-US)股價均走低。

paras_en: September 9, 2026 (Yoo Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Tuesday’s US‑stock focus centered on biotech, index‑component changes and crypto‑related stocks. Amgen (AMGN‑US) slumped more than 5% in pre‑market trading after news of a competing drug’s clinical trial, while Bloom Energy (BE‑US) rose about 4% pre‑market on news it will be added to the S&P 500.

In the biotech sector, Swiss drugmaker Novartis (NOVN‑CH) said an experimental drug failed to reduce cardiovascular risk in late‑stage trials. Because Amgen and Eli Lilly (LLY‑US) are developing competing therapies, the market reassessed the R&D outlook for these drugs: Amgen fell over 5% pre‑market and Eli Lilly’s shares slipped modestly, while Novartis plunged 10% in the European market.
Regarding index changes, S&P Dow Jones Indices announced that fuel‑cell company Bloom Energy will be incorporated into the S&P 500 later this month, sending the stock up more than 10% on Tuesday.
In contrast, Nike (NKE‑US) will be removed from the S&P 100, causing its share price to edge lower.

Crypto‑related stocks were also under pressure. With Bitcoin falling more than 1% to below $78,500, shares of Coinbase Global (COIN‑US), Robinhood Markets (HOOD‑US) and MicroStrategy (MSTR‑US) all moved lower.

items.title: Philip Morris指出台灣市場表現亮眼，無煙產品成全球成長主軸
items.title_en: Philip Morris Highlights Strong Taiwan Market Performance, Smokeless Products as Global Growth Driver
paras: 2026年09月09日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Philip Morris International(PM-US)持續加快從傳統紙菸轉向無煙產品，執行長Jacek Olczak表示，美國ZYN尼古丁袋與IQOS加熱菸仍是主要成長動能，並特別點名台灣市場，表示公司對目前在台灣的表現相當滿意。
但主要原因是Philip Morris過去在台灣傳統紙菸市場的布局較小，因此發展無煙產品時，較不需要面對既有紙菸業務遭到侵蝕的問題，有利公司積極拓展新產品。
Philip Morris同步上調2026年獲利財測，主要受惠匯率環境改善。公司預估全年每股盈餘由原先7.19至7.34美元提高至7.28至7.43美元；調整後每股盈餘則由8.26至8.41美元上修至8.35至8.50美元，相較市場預估8.37美元，新財測區間中高端已高於市場預期。
公司此前與高特力集團Altria(MO-US)旗下Philip Morris USA簽署委託製造協議，由Philip Morris USA為Philip Morris International的非美國關係企業提供生產服務，首批出貨預計於2027年初開始，雙方希望藉此提高營運效率與製造能力。
這項安排並不代表Philip Morris準備重返美國傳統紙菸市場。Philip Morris USA仍屬於Altria旗下菸草事業，雙方維持獨立營運；Philip Morris International也表示，目前仍沒有在美國銷售傳統紙菸的計畫。這項製造合作預期不會對雙方2026年財務表現造成重大影響。
從全球市場來看，日本已成為加熱菸成熟度的重要指標，加熱菸占當地整體尼古丁市場銷量比重已超過50%。儘管2026年至2027年日本接連面臨菸稅與價格調整，Philip Morris表示，加熱菸市場在短期波動後已逐步恢復成長，IQOS仍維持很高的市場地位。
美國則是下一階段最重要的成長市場。Philip Morris認為，美國尼古丁袋市場中長期仍具有20%以上成長潛力，公司近期推出ZYN Ultra並大幅擴充產品組合，過去2個月新增超過20個SKU，同時增加品牌與通路投資，持續擴大ZYN滲透率。
IQOS也可能成為Philip Morris在美國的另一項成長動能。目前公司仍等待美國食品藥物管理局(FDA)對IQOS ILUMA的相關授權，並表示取得許可後已準備好推向市場。Olczak認為，參考其他國家的發展經驗，加熱菸長期有機會占美國紙菸與加熱菸合計市場約10%。

CEO Jacek Olczak said that the US ZYN nicotine pouches and IQOS heated tobacco remain the main growth engines, and he singled out the Taiwan market, stating that the company is very satisfied with its performance there.

The main reason is that Philip Morris had a relatively small footprint in Taiwan’s traditional cigarette market, so when developing smokeless products it faced less cannibalisation of existing cigarette business, facilitating aggressive expansion of new products.

Philip Morris also raised its 2026 earnings outlook, mainly benefiting from an improved currency environment. Both parties hope the arrangement will boost operational efficiency and manufacturing capacity.

The arrangement does not indicate that Philip Morris is preparing to re‑enter the US traditional cigarette market. Philip Morris USA remains part of Altria’s tobacco business and the two entities will continue to operate independently; Philip Morris International also says it has no plans to sell traditional cigarettes in the United States. The manufacturing collaboration is not expected to have a material impact on either side’s 2026 financial results.

Globally, Japan has become a key benchmark for heated‑tobacco maturity, with heated products now accounting for more than 50% of the country’s total nicotine market sales. Despite facing tobacco tax and price adjustments in 2026‑2027, Philip Morris said the heated‑tobacco market has been gradually recovering after short‑term volatility, and IQOS continues to hold a strong market position.

The company recently launched ZYN Ultra and significantly expanded its product portfolio, adding over 20 new SKUs in the past two months, while increasing brand and channel investments to further boost ZYN penetration.

IQOS could also become another growth driver for Philip Morris in the US. The company is awaiting FDA authorization for IQOS ILUMA and says it is ready to launch the product once approval is obtained. items.title: 阿斯特捷利康COPD新藥告捷！年銷售高峰估逾50億美元
items.title_en: AstraZeneca's COPD New Drug Triumphs, Forecasts Over $5 Billion Annual Sales
paras: 英國製藥大廠阿斯特捷利康(AZN-US)周二(8日)公布兩項慢性阻塞性肺病(COPD)後期臨床試驗完整結果，實驗性生物製劑tozorakimab可使廣泛患者族群的中度及重度急性惡化減少約30%，不僅達到或超越分析師預期，也提高這款藥物成為年銷售額逾50億美元重磅產品的希望。
Tozorakimab目前正接受美國食品藥物管理局(FDA)優先審查，預計最快2027年第一季取得美國批准，歐盟與中國等主要市場也在審查中。這款藥物每4周注射一次，在兩項試驗的主要前吸菸者族群中，分別使中度及重度急性惡化減少29%與34%；涵蓋目前及過去吸菸者的整體族群中，降幅則分別達30%與29%。
試驗結果已刊登於《新英格蘭醫學期刊》(New England Journal of Medicine)，並在歐洲呼吸學會年會發表。阿斯特捷利康表示，患者整體耐受性良好，主要不良反應為注射部位反應。

突破現有療法限制 低嗜酸性球患者也受益

COPD是一種會阻塞氣流、造成呼吸困難的漸進性肺部疾病，症狀包括咳嗽、反覆胸腔感染及呼吸急促，目前無法治癒，但治療可延緩惡化。阿斯特捷利康估計，美國確診及未確診患者合計約1,600萬至2,600萬人，COPD也是美國第五大死因。
目前已獲准治療COPD的生物製劑，包括再生元製藥(REGN-US)與賽諾菲(SNY-US)共同開發的Dupixent，以及葛蘭素史克(GSK-US)的Nucala，但主要適用於嗜酸性球數值偏高的患者。嗜酸性球是一種與發炎反應有關的白血球，現有療法僅能涵蓋約30%的COPD患者，其餘約70%患者獲益有限或完全無效。
Tozorakimab試驗則納入現有及過去吸菸者、不同肺功能嚴重程度，以及各種嗜酸性球數值的患者。分析顯示，在嗜酸性球數值低於150的族群中，急性惡化減少23%；數值達150以上者減少34%，300以上者降幅更達43%。
阿斯特捷利康生物製藥事業部總裁Ruud Dobber表示，目前沒有生物製劑可供嗜酸性球數值低於150的COPD患者使用，tozorakimab憑藉廣泛適用性，有機會真正改變治療模式。

阻斷兩條IL-33路徑 年銷售額上看50億美元

Tozorakimab藉由阻斷會引發發炎與黏液生成的免疫蛋白IL-33發揮作用。其他藥廠過去開發抗IL-33療法的成果有限，包括賽諾菲與羅氏(RHHBY-US)旗下藥物均未展現同等成效，導致投資人一度質疑這類療法的潛力。
阿斯特捷利康認為，tozorakimab成功之處在於可同時抑制兩條不同的IL-33路徑，不只能控制發炎，也可能減少黏液生成與呼吸道損傷。執行長蘇博科(Pascal Soriot)坦言，公司原先也認為成功機率不高，市場預測幾乎未替這款藥物計入任何價值，最終結果卻證明藥物有效。
阿斯特捷利康近期將tozorakimab的年銷售高峰預測提高至逾50億美元，可望協助公司實現2030年營收800億美元的目標。該藥目前也正進行重度氣喘第二期試驗及重度病毒性下呼吸道疾病第三期試驗，未來還可能擴及支氣管擴張症等由IL-33驅動的疾病。
不過，密西根大學醫療體系肺部與重症照護部門主管Meilan Han指出，由於尚無試驗直接比較tozorakimab與Dupixent及Nucala，醫師仍須判斷對嗜酸性球偏高患者應優先採用哪種療法，未來需要更多子群分析才能確立其治療定位。
paras_en: AstraZeneca (AZN-US) announced on Tuesday the complete results of two late‑stage clinical trials for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). The experimental biologic tozorakimab reduced moderate and severe acute exacerbations by about 30% across a broad patient population, meeting or exceeding analyst expectations and raising hopes that the drug could become a product generating more than $5 billion in annual sales.

Tozorakimab is currently under priority review by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and could receive U.S. approval as early as the first quarter of 2027, with the European Union, China and other major markets also reviewing it. The drug is administered by injection every four weeks and, in the two trials’ primary former‑smoker cohorts, cut moderate and severe acute exacerbations by 29% and 34% respectively; in the overall population that includes current and former smokers, the reductions were 30% and 29%.

The trial results were published in the New England Journal of Medicine and presented at the European Respiratory Society annual meeting. AstraZeneca said overall tolerability was good, with the main adverse event being injection‑site reactions.

Breaking the limits of existing therapies, even patients with low eosinophil counts benefit. COPD is a progressive lung disease that blocks airflow and causes breathing difficulty, with symptoms such as cough, recurrent chest infections and shortness of breath. It is incurable, but treatment can slow progression. AstraZeneca estimates that 16‑26 million people in the United States have diagnosed or undiagnosed COPD, which is the fifth leading cause of death in the country.

Biologics already approved for COPD include Dupixent, co‑developed by Regeneron (REGN-US) and Sanofi (SNY-US), and Nucala from GlaxoSmithKline (GSK-US), but they are mainly indicated for patients with elevated eosinophil counts. Eosinophils are a type of white blood cell linked to inflammation; current therapies cover only about 30% of COPD patients, leaving roughly 70% with limited or no benefit.

The tozorakimab trials enrolled current and former smokers, patients with varying degrees of lung function impairment, and a range of eosinophil levels. Analyses showed that in patients with eosinophil counts below 150, acute exacerbations fell by 23%; those with counts of 150 or higher saw a 34% reduction, and patients with counts above 300 experienced a 43% drop.

Ruud Dobber, president of AstraZeneca’s biopharma division, said there is currently no biologic available for COPD patients with eosinophil counts below 150, and that tozorakimab’s broad applicability could truly change the treatment paradigm.

Blocking two IL‑33 pathways could drive $5 billion in annual sales. Tozorakimab works by blocking the immune protein IL‑33, which triggers inflammation and mucus production. Other companies’ attempts at anti‑IL‑33 therapies have yielded limited results, including drugs from Sanofi and Roche (RHHBY-US), leading investors to question the potential of this approach.

AstraZeneca believes tozorakimab’s success lies in its ability to inhibit two distinct IL‑33 pathways simultaneously, not only controlling inflammation but also potentially reducing mucus production and airway damage. CEO Pascal Soriot admitted the company originally thought the odds of success were low and that market forecasts had assigned virtually no value to the drug, yet the outcome proved the drug’s efficacy.

AstraZeneca has recently raised its peak‑year sales forecast for tozorakimab to over $5 billion, which could help the company reach its goal of $80 billion in revenue by 2030. The drug is also in phase‑2 trials for severe asthma and phase‑3 trials for severe viral lower‑respiratory‑tract disease, and may later be tested in other IL‑33‑driven conditions such as bronchiectasis.

However, Meilan Han, head of pulmonary and critical care at the University of Michigan Health System, cautioned that because no head‑to‑head trials have compared tozorakimab with Dupixent or Nucala, physicians must still decide which therapy to prioritize for patients with high eosinophil counts. More subgroup analyses will be needed in the future to define its therapeutic positioning.

items.title: USD/JPY：日圓升至七個月高點、逼近153日圓，市場幾乎已消化日本央行升息預期
paras: 要點：

日圓持續大幅升值
一週內從160日圓升至153日圓
市場已消化日本央行升息預期


美元兌日圓在短短一週內，已從160日圓上方一路跌向153日圓附近。偏偏就在你剛平掉空單的時候，對吧？
日圓突破干預價位

週二，USD/JPY跌向153日圓，使日圓升至2月以來最強水準。就在上週，美元兌日圓還一度突破160日圓，意味著短短幾天內，日圓已升值約4%。



此波走勢使美元兌日圓跌破日本與美國在7月聯手干預後所觸及的價位。



日本當局在7月30日至8月26日期間動用創紀錄的15.4兆日圓（965億美元）支撐日圓。這一次，推動日圓走強的主要力量則來自貨幣政策預期。



交易員正在回補先前累積的日圓空頭部位。當時日本利率明顯低於其他已開發市場，因此交易員大量放空日圓。這些部位通常用於套利交易：以低利率借入日圓，再購買其他市場中殖利率較高的資產。


日本央行升息更近一步

日本將第二季經濟成長率上修至年化1.4%，主要受到企業投資強於預期的支撐。



7月實質薪資年增2.4%，創2021年5月以來最大增幅，並連續第七個月成長。購買力提升，讓日本經濟有更大的空間承受較高的借貸成本。



目前掉期市場顯示，日本央行於9月18日將政策利率上調25個基點至1.25%的機率約為98%。市場也已完全反映1月前進一步升息至1.5%的預期。



財務大臣片山皐月表示，在罕見的聯合干預行動後，東京與華盛頓仍保持一致，致力於推動匯率市場維持穩定。


CPI可能打斷日圓漲勢

美元方面的情況仍然複雜。8月非農就業人數增加162,000人，接近市場預期的三倍，使聯準會下週升息的機率升至約60%。



通常而言，美國利率上升會擴大美元資產的殖利率優勢，進而支撐美元兌日圓。



然而，美元指數週二跌至約98.80的兩週低點。財政疑慮以及美國通膨數據公布前的謹慎情緒正在限制美元的反應。


現在該關注什麼

美國生產者物價指數（PPI）將於週四公布，接著週五公布消費者物價指數（CPI）。若數據偏高，可能推高美國國債殖利率，甚至在日本央行出手前就引發美元強勁反彈。
從圖表來看，153日圓是眼前的重要樞紐位，接下來則是152日圓，以及具有心理意義的150日圓關卡。阻力位則位於前次干預後形成的約155日圓附近。
若價格持續跌破該區域，將確認趨勢已經轉變；但若美國CPI數據偏高，也可能提醒日圓多頭，目前正有兩家央行爭相扮演「鷹派」角色。

items.title_en: Yang Jin‑long’s Central Bank Governor Career Earns “A‑” Rating for the Third Time
paras: 環球金融(Global Finance)雜誌公布2026 年央行總裁評比，台灣央行總裁楊金龍連續兩年拿下「A-」，也是楊金龍總裁生涯中第三度拿「A-」，楊金龍今(8)日對此回應，「謝謝大家，我會和央行同仁持續努力」。
A級評比有「A+」、「A」或「A-」，與央行同樣拿下「A-」有捷克、菲律賓、波蘭、瑞士、阿拉伯聯合大公國等主要國家。
而獲「A+」評比的僅丹麥、祕魯；「A」級名單有印度、新加坡、南非、智利等國。
環球金融自1994年起每年發布對近100個主要國家、地區等地的央行總裁評比，評分採「A+」至「F」的等級制，評估指標涵蓋通膨控制、經濟成長目標實現、貨幣穩定性、利率管理和政治獨立性等領域。
環球金融創辦人Joseph Giarraputo表示，央行總裁需要在持續的通膨壓力、不確定的成長前景和瞬息萬變的經濟情勢中運籌帷幄，又要維持市場信心，能獲得A級肯定的央行總裁都是具獨立性和審慎判斷力的領導者。
paras_en: Global Finance magazine released its 2026 central‑bank governor rankings, and Taiwan’s central bank governor Yang Jin‑long secured an “A‑” for the second consecutive year, marking the third time in his tenure he has earned an “A‑.” Yang said on the 8th that he thanks everyone and will continue to work hard together with his colleagues at the central bank.
The “A” tier includes “A+,” “A” and “A‑.” Other major economies that also received an “A‑” rating this year are the Czech Republic, the Philippines, Poland, Switzerland and the United Arab Emirates.
Only Denmark and Peru achieved the top “A+” rating, while the “A” list features India, Singapore, South Africa, Chile and others.

Since 1994, Global Finance has published annual rankings of central‑bank governors for roughly 100 major countries and regions, using a scale from “A+” down to “F.” The assessment criteria cover inflation control, achievement of economic‑growth targets, monetary stability, interest‑rate management and political independence.

Joseph Giarraputo, founder of Global Finance, said that central‑bank governors must navigate persistent inflation pressures, uncertain growth prospects and rapidly changing economic conditions while maintaining market confidence. Those who receive an “A” rating are leaders who demonstrate independence and prudent judgment.

items.title: 日元走強之下 10年期日債殖利率自高點回落
items.title_en: Yen Strength Pushes 10-Year Japanese Bond Yield Down from Peak
paras: 隨著日元匯率攀升至7個月新高，進口成本與通膨壓力降溫，日本10年期公債殖利率周二(8日)回落至約2.89%，延續了先前從30年高點回落的趨勢。
此前，日本10年期公債殖利率於9月1日一度攀升至3%大關，創下1996年以來的新高，相較於2025年8月已大漲超過1.4個百分點。
東京外匯市場上，美元兌日元周二一度下跌至1美元兌152日元區間，日元走強通常會降低進口成本，有助於抑制通膨。
這次波動的核心源於日本央行(BOJ)貨幣政策正常化的腳步。日銀於2026年6月將政策利率調升至1.0%。日銀審議委員高田創指出，未來不排除採取更大幅度或連續升息的可能性；日銀總裁植田和男也強調，決策者需密切留意物價上行的風險。
首相高市早苗的經濟顧問會田卓司表示，日銀很可能在9月再度升息，並於明年1月前再度調高利率；儘管他同時警告，加速升息可能會對經濟造成負擔。
與此同時，雖然日元走強，但市場分析指出，日元利差交易尚未真正全面平倉。根據《Fxstreet》分析，目前僅是日元融資成本被重新定價，利差交易持有的龐大部位依然續存。在日銀鷹派立場與高市政府擴張性財政政策帶來的債務付息壓力下，日本金融市場的變革仍將牽動全球資金流向。
paras_en: As the yen rose to a seven‑month high, import costs and inflation pressure eased, and Japan's 10‑year government bond yield fell on Tuesday (the 8th) to about 2.89%, continuing the decline from a three‑decade peak.

Earlier, the 10‑year Japanese government bond yield had briefly surged to the 3% mark on September 1, a new high not seen since 1996, representing an increase of more than 1.4 percentage points since August 2025.
In the Tokyo foreign‑exchange market, the dollar fell to the 152 yen per dollar range on Tuesday; a stronger yen usually lowers import costs and helps curb inflation.

The volatility stems from the Bank of Japan’s move toward policy normalization. The BOJ raised its policy rate to 1.0% in June 2026. Governor Takahiro Takata said larger or consecutive rate hikes cannot be ruled out, and Governor Kazuo Ueda stressed that policymakers must closely monitor upward price risks.

Prime Minister Sanae Kōchi’s economic adviser Takashi Aida said the BOJ is likely to raise rates again in September and lift them further before January 2027, though he warned that accelerating hikes could burden the economy.

At the same time, despite the yen’s strength, analysts note that yen carry‑trade positions have not been fully unwound. Fxstreet points out that only the financing cost of the yen has been re‑priced, while the large carry‑trade positions remain, and the BOJ’s hawkish stance combined with the expansionary fiscal policy of the Kōchi administration will keep debt‑service pressure shaping Japan’s financial markets and influencing global capital flows.

items.title: 逼近今年新高！日元兌美元9月迄今強升3.8%  152成關鍵防線
items.title_en: Approaching This Year's New High! Yen Gains 3.8% Against the Dollar So Far in September, 152 as a Key Defense Line
paras: 日元兌美元匯率週二(8日)持續走升，一度升值0.5%至153.53，本月迄今累計升值近3.8%，為G10最強貨幣，目前交易員目標直指152區域。
日元持續走強，主要係因美國假期流動性偏薄，跌破155加速了原本看多行情，加上日本央行(BOJ)升息預期升溫、市場揣測GPIF調整資產配置，也提振日元。熟悉匯市交易人士指出，跌破155觸發止損，並迫使選擇權交易員拋售美元。
澳洲國民銀行策略師Rodrigo Catril表示，美元兌日元貶破155支撐「為進一步下行打開大門」，料將下探152.27與152.1前低，152.1則為今年最強支撐，技術指標亦指向152。
隨著波動加劇，套利交易平倉風險升溫。SMBC日興證券資深利率與外匯分析師丸山倫人(Rinto Maruyama)指出，若美元兌日圓貶破154，恐觸發更多平倉與止損，為日元持續升值留出空間，但也讓投資人有空間重建空單。
目前，市場關注周五(11日)公布的美國通膨數據、日本央行委員Kazuyuki Masu談話，以及下周央行會議。
隔夜指數掉期數據顯示，BOJ下周升息1碼機率達97%。Catril形容日元正處十字路口，升息是必要條件，但要維持聲勢，BOJ須釋出鷹派信號，並強化年底前再升息預期。
paras_en: The yen‑dollar exchange rate continued to rise on Tuesday (the 8th), at one point appreciating 0.5% to 153.53. It has gained nearly 3.8% so far this month, making it the strongest G10 currency, and traders are now targeting the 152 area.

The yen’s ongoing strength is mainly due to thin US holiday liquidity, which accelerated the bullish move after breaking below 155, combined with rising expectations of a BOJ rate hike and market speculation that the GPIF is adjusting its asset allocation, all of which have bolstered the yen. Experienced FX market participants note that breaking below 155 triggers stop‑loss orders and forces options traders to sell dollars.

ANZ strategist Rodrigo Catril said the dollar‑yen dip below the 155 support “opens the door for further downside,” forecasting a test of 152.27 and the previous low of 152.1, with 152.1 being the strongest support this year, and technical indicators also pointing to 152.

As volatility intensifies, the risk of arbitrage unwind rises. SMBC Nikko Securities senior rates and FX analyst Rinto Maruyama warned that if USD/JPY falls below 154, it could trigger additional unwindings and stop‑losses, leaving room for continued yen appreciation while also giving investors space to rebuild short positions.
The market is currently focused on Friday’s (the 11th) US inflation data release, remarks by BOJ board member Kazuyuki Masu, and next week’s central‑bank meetings.

Overnight index‑swap data show a 97% probability that the BOJ will raise rates by one basis point next week. Catril describes the yen as being at a crossroads; a rate hike is a necessary condition, but to maintain momentum the BOJ must issue hawkish signals and reinforce expectations of another hike before year‑end.

items.title: 美債再承壓！德銀：挪威主權財富基金料大舉調整配置策略 日元、日債最受益
items.title_en: US Treasuries Under Pressure Again! Deutsche Bank: Norwegian Sovereign Wealth Fund Likely to Make Major Allocation Shift, Yen and Japanese Bonds Benefit Most
paras: 德意志銀行最新表示，規模達2.2兆美元的挪威主權財富基金近日提議調整投資策略，恐導致對日本國債的配置大幅增加。
德銀外匯策略師Shreyas Gopal和George Saravelos在最新研究報告中寫道：「雖然涉及的金額相對於全球固定收益市場的規模較小，但我們認為，作為全球規模最大、最成功的主權財富基金之一，其投資策略變化有力地表明，當前全球資本流動和投資組合配置正在發生緩慢但持續的轉變。」
報告指出，挪威承認主權債務不再是無風險資產，並正將其美國固定收益資產配置從美債轉向非主權固定收益資產。
挪威主權財富基金也正在大幅轉向日本國債，進而「承認其市場規模龐大，並降低債務佔GDP比重作為市場配置指標的重要性」。
對此德銀認為，這種配置策略上的傾斜意味著受益最大的國家和貨幣是日元。
paras_en: Deutsche Bank recently stated that the Norwegian sovereign wealth fund, with a size of $2.2 trillion, has proposed adjusting its investment strategy, potentially leading to a significant increase in its allocation to Japanese government bonds.

In its latest research report, Deutsche Bank foreign‑exchange strategists Shreyas Gopal and George Saravelos wrote: "Although the amount involved is relatively small compared to the global fixed‑income market, we believe that as the world’s largest and most successful sovereign wealth fund, its shift in investment strategy strongly indicates that global capital flows and portfolio allocations are undergoing a slow but steady transformation."
The report notes that Norway acknowledges that sovereign debt is no longer risk‑free and is shifting its U.S. fixed‑income allocation from U.S. Treasuries to non‑sovereign fixed‑income assets.

The Norwegian sovereign wealth fund is also making a large shift toward Japanese government bonds, thereby "recognizing the vast market size and reducing the importance of debt-to‑GDP ratio as a key market allocation metric."
Deutsche Bank believes that this tilt in allocation strategy means that the country and currency that will benefit the most is the yen.

Last Friday's data showed U.S. non‑farm payrolls jumped by 162,000 in August, far above expectations and the biggest increase in five months, while the unemployment rate held at 4.1%, suggesting an improving labor market. This prompted the market to increase bets on further Fed rate hikes, and Cleveland Fed President Mester again reiterated support for tightening. Meanwhile, the U.S.–Iran conflict entered its seventh month with renewed fighting, pushing oil prices higher and adding inflation pressure globally, which boosted safe‑haven demand for the dollar. In addition, the Japanese government announced on Monday that foreign‑exchange reserves fell 6.18% to $120.75 billion as of end‑August, down $79.6 billion from the previous month's $128.7 billion – the largest drop on record, reflecting Japan’s recent record‑size intervention of selling dollars and buying yen to curb the yen’s decline, which weighed on the yen and helped the USD/JPY reach a high of 156.27.

Subsequently, Japanese Prime Minister Kishida’s economic adviser Takashi Aita said the Bank of Japan is likely to raise rates in September and continue quarterly hikes through January 2025. The market has almost fully priced in a 25‑basis‑point increase to 1.25% at the BOJ meeting on September 17‑18, and exporters are selling when the USD/JPY rebounds. A mix of repatriating funds, unwind of carry trades, U.S. political pressure and expectations of a faster BOJ tightening pace are reinforcing the view that the severely weakened yen is reversing, spurring a sharp yen rally. With the U.S. holiday market thin, the dollar fell to a low of 154.04 against the yen. Today's USD/JPY resistance is seen at 153.80‑154.00, support at 152.00‑152.20.

The market assigns an 80% probability that the Reserve Bank of New Zealand will hold rates steady next month, keeping the kiwi weak. However, ANZ and job site Indeed reported that August Australian job ads rose 2.5% month‑on‑month and 7.8% year‑on‑year, marking a fourth consecutive month of growth and indicating strong labor demand, aided by iron‑ore prices hitting a one‑month high, which pushed the Aussie dollar higher and helped the euro hold the USD/EUR low at 1.1601.

According to Germany’s Federal Statistics Office, July industrial production unexpectedly fell 1.1% from the previous month, but the Euro‑zone September Sentix investor confidence index climbed to a four‑year‑plus high of 5.1 points, signalling improving economic outlook and current conditions, and boosting confidence in the recovery. Eurostat also revised Q2 Euro‑zone GDP up by 0.6% quarter‑on‑quarter, beating expectations. The market expects the ECB to raise rates in September and again by 25 bps in December, which could lift the euro to a high of 1.1635 against the dollar. Today's EUR/USD support is projected at 1.1600‑1.1620, resistance at 1.1680‑1.1700.

Monday’s data from the UK Recruitment and Employment Confederation (REC) and KPMG showed the UK’s August vacancy index rose 50.5 points – the first increase since September 2022. Yet data from LendInvest indicated that the US‑Iran conflict has pushed borrowing costs higher, causing some home‑buyers to delay purchases, which led UK house prices to fall 0.2% month‑on‑month and 0.4% year‑on‑year in August, the first declines in nearly three years. This pulled the pound down to a low of 1.3501 against the dollar. Afterwards, Chancellor Jeremy Hunt delivered his first speech since taking office, outlining plans to give cities greater powers to attract private investment and spur growth, which lifted the pound to a high of 1.3547. Today's GBP/USD support is seen at 1.3510‑1.3530, resistance at 1.3600‑1.3620.

週一，EURUSD維持在1.16美元附近，儘管全球利率預期出現大幅重新定價，歐元仍沒有太大波動。
貨幣對的平靜走勢反映多股力量的拉鋸：市場預期歐洲央行本週升息，可能支撐歐元；另一方面，週五強勁的美國就業數據則強化了美元的殖利率優勢。
市場普遍預期ECB將於週四把存款利率上調25個基點至2.50%。這將是自6月政策制定者開始因應能源推動的通膨以來，第二次升息。
歐元區8月通膨率從2.9% 加速至3.3%，主要受到能源價格上漲推動。排除波動較大的食品與燃料價格後，核心通膨率則降至2.4%。


油價讓 ECB 的政策訊息更加複雜


週末美國與伊朗在荷姆茲海峽附近攻擊船隻後，布蘭特原油價格一度逼近97美元。途經該航線的航運量大幅下降，增加長期運輸中斷的風險。
歐洲高度依賴能源進口，因此高油價對當地家庭與企業尤其不利。
升息決策本身可能已幾乎完全反映在市場價格中，因此歐元更大的反應可能來自Christine Lagarde的政策指引。
偏鷹派的政策展望 — 也就是暗示利率可能進一步上升的措辭 — 可能推高歐洲債券殖利率並支撐歐元。相反地，若釋放出謹慎的「升息一次就結束」訊息，可能使歐元走弱。


CPI 決定美元的下一步


在大西洋彼岸，美國8月新增162,000個工作職位，接近市場預期56,000個的三倍，而失業率維持在4.1%。交易員目前認為聯準會下週升息的機率約為57%。
美國生產者物價指數（PPI）將於週四公佈，消費者物價指數（CPI）則於週五公佈。若通膨數據偏高，將強化聯準會升息的理由，可能推動歐元兌美元跌破1.16美元，進一步測試1.1550與1.1500附近的支撐。
若通膨數據低於預期，則可能挑戰美元多頭，讓該貨幣對再次測試1.1660–1.1700。值得注意的是，儘管非農就業數據強勁、升息預期升溫，美元週一的漲幅仍然有限。
美國財政疑慮，以及海灣地區衝突可能帶來的通膨影響，似乎正在限制美元的需求。即使週一美國民眾放假休市，市場也早已很難再享受平靜的數據日曆。

The euro remained stable around $1.16 on Thursday ahead of the rate decision. Despite a major repricing of global rate expectations, the EUR/USD pair showed little movement. The calm price action reflects a tug‑of‑war: markets expect the European Central Bank to raise rates this week, which could support the euro, while Friday’s strong U.S. jobs data bolsters the dollar’s yield advantage. The consensus is that the ECB will lift the deposit rate by 25 basis points to 2.50% on Thursday – the second hike since policymakers began reacting to energy‑driven inflation in June. Euro‑area inflation accelerated from 2.9% to 3.3% in August, driven mainly by higher energy prices, while core inflation (excluding volatile food and fuel) fell to 2.4%.

Oil prices add complexity to the ECB’s policy signal. After U.S. and Iranian attacks on vessels near the Hormuz Strait over the weekend, Brent crude briefly approached $97 per barrel, and shipping traffic through the strait has sharply declined, raising the risk of prolonged transport disruptions. Europe’s heavy reliance on imported energy makes high oil prices especially harmful to households and businesses. The rate‑rise decision itself is likely already priced in, so the euro’s next move may hinge on Christine Lagarde’s guidance. A more hawkish outlook – hinting further rate hikes – could push European bond yields higher and support the euro, whereas a cautious “one‑time hike only” message could weaken it. In the U.S., August added 162,000 jobs, nearly three times the 56,000 forecast, with unemployment steady at 4.1%. Traders see about a 57% chance of a Fed hike next week. The PPI is due Thursday and CPI on Friday; higher‑than‑expected inflation would reinforce a Fed hike, potentially pulling EUR/USD below 1.16 and testing support around 1.1550‑1.1500. Lower inflation could challenge the dollar’s rally and let the pair retest 1.1660‑1.1700. Despite strong payrolls and rising rate‑hike expectations, the dollar’s gain on Monday was modest. Fiscal concerns in the U.S. and inflation risks from Middle‑East conflicts appear to be capping dollar demand, and even with a U.S. holiday, markets are finding it hard to enjoy a quiet data calendar.
